    --Account premium table load

    PROCEDURE prc_load_actpremium_details IS

        v_cnt NUMBER;

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.ACCT_PRM';

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- Begin P1'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

 

        --DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.STAGE_ACCOUNT_PREMIUM_DETAILS; --Can be removed after testing to delete rows if already inserted.

 

        --COMMIT;

 

        MERGE INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_premium_details a

        USING (

            SELECT

                account_no,

                actlvl_premium,

                flag,

                policy_no,

                inception_dt

            FROM

                STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

            WHERE

                    month_sk = v_month_sk

                AND active_in = 'Y'

        ) b ON ( a.account_no = b.account_no

                 AND a.policy_no = b.policy_no

                 AND a.effective_dt = b.inception_dt )

        WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE

        SET a.annual_premium_am = b.actlvl_premium

        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN

        INSERT (

            account_no,

            annual_premium_am,

            aig_acct_gt_10k,

            policy_no,

            effective_dt )

        VALUES

            ( b.account_no,

              b.actlvl_premium,

              b.flag,

              b.policy_no,

              b.inception_dt );

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- End P1'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_load_actpremium_details;

 

    --manual policies

    PROCEDURE prc_load_policy_history_manual (

        in_ym                NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') ),

        in_future_no_of_days NUMBER DEFAULT 0

    ) IS

 

        v_cnt                     NUMBER;

        v_sql                     VARCHAR2(4000);

        v_sql1                    VARCHAR2(4000);

        TYPE typ_acc_pol_validations IS REF CURSOR;

        t_acc_pol_validations     typ_acc_pol_validations;

        r_acc_pol_validations     STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details%rowtype;

        v_pol_prm                 tdaily_inforce_policy.annual_premium_am%TYPE;

        v_old_prm                 tdaily_inforce_policy.annual_premium_am%TYPE;

        v_modified_prm_am         STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details.premium_am%TYPE;

        r_gtt_inforce_pol_details STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details%rowtype;

        v_active_policy           BOOLEAN;

        TYPE rec_cancelled_policy_det IS RECORD (

                premium_am             tendorsement.premium_am%TYPE,

                policy_status_tx       tpolicy.policy_status_tx%TYPE,

                previous_pcg_policy_no tpolicy.previous_pcg_policy_no%TYPE,

                reissued_pcg_policy_no tpolicy.reissued_pcg_policy_no%TYPE

        );

        r_cancelled_policy_det    rec_cancelled_policy_det;

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.HISTORY_MANUAL';

        v_ym := in_ym;

        v_date := sysdate;

        v_rows_processed := 0;

        v_log_params := '(in_YM==>'

                        || v_ym

                        || ');';

        pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

    --Get Month SK, Prev Month Sk, month begin SK, END SK (01-JAN, 31-JAN for example) etc.,

        SELECT

            date_sk,

            actual_dt

        INTO

            v_month_sk,

            v_fulldate

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

                year_month_ct = v_ym

            AND month_end_in = 'Y';

 

        SELECT

            date_sk

        INTO v_prev_month_sk

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

                year_month_ct = to_char((add_months(v_fulldate, - 1)),

                                        'yyyymm')

            AND month_end_in = 'Y';

 

        SELECT

            MIN(date_sk),

            MAX(date_sk)

        INTO

            v_begin_date_sk,

            v_end_date_sk

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

            year_month_ct = v_ym;

 

         /* Selecting month begin date and enddate-1 */

        SELECT

            actual_dt

        INTO v_begin_date

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

            date_sk = v_begin_date_sk;

 

        v_end_date := v_fulldate - 1;

         /********************************************/

 

        SELECT

            date_sk,

            actual_dt

        INTO

            v_yr_begin_dt_sk,

            v_yr_begin_act_dt

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

            ( date_sk, year_ct ) IN (

                SELECT

                    MIN(date_sk), MAX(year_ct) year_ct

                FROM

                    tdate

                WHERE

                    substr(year_month_ct, 1, 4) = substr(v_ym, 1, 4)

            );

 

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- Delete Data'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

        WHERE

            month_sk = v_month_sk;

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details;

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.policy_tran_prmind_details;

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.tlog_missing_tran_policies

        WHERE

            month_sk = v_month_sk;

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_policy_details;

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.gtt_cust_act_details;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '02- Before data Insert'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        SELECT

            COUNT(*)

        INTO v_cnt

        FROM

            STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

        WHERE

                month_sk = v_prev_month_sk

            AND ROWNUM <= 1;

 

        IF v_cnt = 0 THEN

            --Insert all Active policies from Jan 2019 to Dec 2019  in the first run

            INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.policy_tran_prmind_details (

                policy_sk,

                date_sk,

                customer_sk,

                premium_am,

                original_premium_am,

                inception_dt

            )

                SELECT

                    pol.policy_sk,

                    v_month_sk,

                    t.customer_sk,

                    SUM(premium_am)                                                                     premium, --KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY TRANSACTION_DT_SK, POLICY_STATUS_SK) premium,

                    SUM(premium_am) KEEP(DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY transaction_dt_sk, policy_status_sk) original_premium_am,

                    pol.inception_dt

                FROM

                    ttransaction t,

                    tdate        d,

                    tpolicy      pol

                WHERE

                        t.calendar_month_sk = d.date_sk

                    AND t.calendar_month_sk <> 0

                    AND t.policy_sk = pol.policy_sk

                    AND pol.inception_dt >= TO_DATE('01-JAN-2019')

                    AND pol.inception_dt <= TO_DATE('31-DEC-2019')

                    AND pol.policy_status_tx <> 'Cancelled'

                GROUP BY

                    t.customer_sk,

                    pol.policy_sk,

                    pol.inception_dt;

 

            COMMIT;

        END IF;

 

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.policy_tran_prmind_details (

            policy_sk,

            date_sk,

            customer_sk,

            premium_am,

            original_premium_am,

            inception_dt

        )

            SELECT

                pol.policy_sk,

                v_month_sk,

                t.customer_sk,

               --SUM ( premium_am ) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY endorsement_no) premium,

               --SUM (annual_premium_am) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY endorsement_no) annual_premium_am,

                SUM(premium_am)                                                                     premium, --KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY TRANSACTION_DT_SK, POLICY_STATUS_SK) premium,

                SUM(premium_am) KEEP(DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY transaction_dt_sk, policy_status_sk) original_premium_am,

                pol.inception_dt

            FROM

                ttransaction t,

                tdate        d,

                tpolicy      pol

            WHERE

                    t.calendar_month_sk = d.date_sk

                AND t.calendar_month_sk <> 0

                AND t.policy_sk = pol.policy_sk

                AND pol.inception_dt >= v_yr_begin_act_dt

                AND t.calendar_month_sk >= v_yr_begin_dt_sk

                AND pol.inception_dt <= v_fulldate + in_future_no_of_days    --Restrict the future renewal date for 45 days.

            GROUP BY

                t.customer_sk,

                pol.policy_sk,

                pol.inception_dt;

 

        COMMIT;

        UPDATE STAGE_MISREG.policy_tran_prmind_details a

        SET

            a.original_premium_am = a.premium_am

        WHERE

                a.inception_dt >= '01-JAN-2020'

            AND a.policy_sk IN (

                SELECT

                    policy_sk

                FROM

                    tpolicy b

                WHERE

                        a.policy_sk = b.policy_sk

                    AND b.policy_status_tx = 'Active'

            );

 

        COMMIT;

        IF v_cnt = 0 THEN

            INSERT  /*+ APPEND */ INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details (

                month_sk,

                account_no,

                policy_no,

                inception_dt,

                premium_am,

                original_premium_am,

                active_in,

                zip_cd,

                customer_nm,

                customer_no,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm,

                policy_status_tx,

                expiration_dt

            )

                SELECT

                    v_month_sk,

                    account_no,

                    pol.policy_no,

                    pol.inception_dt,

                    premium_am          premium_am,

                    original_premium_am original_premium_am,

                    'Y',

                    zip_cd,

                    customer_nm,

                    cust.customer_id,

                    pol.policy_sk,

                    pol.source_system_nm,

                    pol.policy_status_tx,

                    pol.expiration_dt

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.policy_tran_prmind_details inf,

                    tdate                            td,

                    tcustomer                        cust,

                    tpolicy                          pol

                WHERE

                        inf.customer_sk = cust.customer_sk

                    AND inf.date_sk = td.date_sk

                    AND pol.policy_sk = inf.policy_sk

                    AND td.date_sk = v_month_sk

                    AND pol.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 15, 2, 14 )

                    AND nvl(pol.uw_co_cd, ' ') NOT IN ( 'AHACC', 'AICC' );

 

            v_rows_processed := SQL%rowcount;

            COMMIT;

        ELSE

            --Copy previous month data into current month with flag as Inactive and later make it active looping each policy for validations.

            INSERT  /*+ APPEND */ INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details (

                month_sk,

                account_no,

                policy_no,

                inception_dt,

                premium_am,

                original_premium_am,

                flag,

                active_in,

                zip_cd,

                customer_nm,

                customer_no,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm,

                policy_status_tx,

                expiration_dt

            )

                SELECT

                    v_month_sk,

                    account_no,

                    policy_no,

                    inception_dt,

                    premium_am,

                    original_premium_am,

                    flag,

                    'Y' active_in,

                    zip_cd,

                    customer_nm,

                    customer_no,

                    policy_sk,

                    source_system_nm,

                    policy_status_tx,

                    expiration_dt

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

                WHERE

                        month_sk = v_prev_month_sk

                    AND active_in = 'Y';

 

            v_rows_processed := SQL%rowcount;

            COMMIT;

            dbms_output.put_line('--1--');

        --Update all records premium amount as of now.

            MERGE /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(8) */ INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details a

            USING (

                SELECT

                    month_sk,

                    policy_sk,

                    inforce_prm_am

                FROM

                    tpolicy_summary b

                WHERE

                        month_sk = v_month_sk

                    AND inforce_ct = 1

                    AND snapshot_type_in = 0

            ) b ON ( a.month_sk = b.month_sk

                     AND a.policy_sk = b.policy_sk )

            WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE

            SET premium_am = b.inforce_prm_am

            WHERE

                    month_sk = v_month_sk

                AND policy_status_tx = 'Active';

 

            COMMIT;

            dbms_output.put_line('--2--');

        --update all Account_no, customer_no, name, etc., when customer moved from one account to another account....

            INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.gtt_cust_act_details (

                month_sk,

                policy_sk,

                customer_id,

                account_no,

                customer_nm

            )

                SELECT

                    a.month_sk,

                    a.policy_sk,

                    a.customer_id,

                    a.account_no,

                    a.customer_nm

                FROM

                    (

                        SELECT

                            a.month_sk,

                            a.policy_sk,

                            b.customer_id,

                            b.account_no,

                            b.zip_cd,

                            b.customer_nm

                        FROM

                            tpolicy_summary a,

                            tcustomer       b

                        WHERE

                                a.customer_sk = b.customer_sk

                            AND a.month_sk = v_month_sk

                            AND a.inforce_ct = 1

                            AND a.snapshot_type_in = 0

                    ) a,

                    (

                        SELECT

                            month_sk,

                            policy_sk,

                            customer_no,

                            account_no,

                            zip_cd,

                            customer_nm

                        FROM

                            STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

                        WHERE

                                month_sk = v_month_sk

                            AND policy_status_tx = 'Active'

                    ) b

                WHERE

                        a.month_sk = b.month_sk

                    AND a.policy_sk = b.policy_sk

                    AND ( a.customer_id <> b.customer_no

                          OR a.account_no <> b.account_no )

                    AND a.month_sk = v_month_sk;

 

            COMMIT;

            dbms_output.put_line('--3--');

            MERGE /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(8) */ INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details a

            USING (

                SELECT

                    month_sk,

                    policy_sk,

                    customer_id,

                    account_no,

                    customer_nm

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.gtt_cust_act_details

                WHERE

                    month_sk = v_month_sk

            ) b ON ( a.month_sk = b.month_sk

                     AND a.policy_sk = b.policy_sk )

            WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE

            SET a.account_no = b.account_no,

                a.customer_no = b.customer_id,

                a.customer_nm = b.customer_nm

            WHERE

                    month_sk = v_month_sk

                AND policy_status_tx = 'Active';

 

            COMMIT;

            dbms_output.put_line('--4--');

           --Insert the current active policies into GTT table.

            INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details (

                month_sk,

                account_no,

                policy_no,

                inception_dt,

                premium_am,

                zip_cd,

                customer_nm,

                customer_no,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm,

                policy_status_tx,

                expiration_dt,

                original_premium_am

            )

                SELECT

                    v_month_sk,

                    account_no,

                    pol.policy_no,

                    pol.inception_dt,

                    premium_am,

                    zip_cd,

                    customer_nm,

                    cust.customer_id,

                    pol.policy_sk,

                    pol.source_system_nm,

                    pol.policy_status_tx,

                    pol.expiration_dt,

                    original_premium_am

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.policy_tran_prmind_details inf,

                    tdate                            td,

                    tcustomer                        cust,

                    tpolicy                          pol

                WHERE

                        inf.customer_sk = cust.customer_sk

                    AND inf.date_sk = td.date_sk

                    AND pol.policy_sk = inf.policy_sk

                    AND td.date_sk = v_month_sk

                    AND pol.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 15, 2, 14 )

                    AND nvl(pol.uw_co_cd, ' ') NOT IN ( 'AHACC', 'AICC' );

 

            COMMIT;

            dbms_output.put_line('--5--');

            --Add new account #s added after last month insertion

            -------------------------------------------------------

            INSERT  /*+ APPEND */ INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details (

                month_sk,

                account_no,

                policy_no,

                inception_dt,

                premium_am,

                original_premium_am,

                active_in,

                zip_cd,

                customer_nm,

                customer_no,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm,

                policy_status_tx,

                expiration_dt

            )

                SELECT

                    month_sk,

                    account_no,

                    policy_no,

                    inception_dt,

                    premium_am,

                    original_premium_am,

                    'Y',

                    zip_cd,

                    customer_nm,

                    customer_no,

                    policy_sk,

                    source_system_nm,

                    policy_status_tx,

                    expiration_dt

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details

                WHERE

                    account_no IN (

                        SELECT

                            account_no

                        FROM

                            STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details

                        MINUS

                        SELECT

                            account_no

                        FROM

                            STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

                        WHERE

                            month_sk = v_month_sk

                    );

 

            v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

            COMMIT;

        END IF;

 

        dbms_output.put_line('--6--');

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_policy_details (

            policy_no,

            inception_dt

        )

            SELECT

                policy_no,

                inception_dt

            FROM

                STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

            WHERE

                month_sk = v_month_sk;

 

        COMMIT;

        dbms_output.put_line('--7--');

        --Insert any new policies got added on existing account.

        --Same policy with renewal effective date will also added here.

        INSERT  /*+ APPEND */ INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details (

            month_sk,

            account_no,

            policy_no,

            inception_dt,

            premium_am,

            original_premium_am,

            active_in,

            zip_cd,

            customer_nm,

            customer_no,

            policy_sk,

            source_system_nm,

            policy_status_tx,

            expiration_dt

        )

            SELECT

                month_sk,

                account_no,

                policy_no,

                inception_dt,

                premium_am,

                original_premium_am,

                'Y',

                zip_cd,

                customer_nm,

                customer_no,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm,

                policy_status_tx,

                expiration_dt

            FROM

                STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details

            WHERE

                ( policy_no, inception_dt ) IN (

                    SELECT

                        policy_no, inception_dt

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details

                    MINUS

                    SELECT

                        policy_no, inception_dt

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_policy_details

                );

 

        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        v_log_params := v_module_name

                        || ' - '

                        || to_char(v_rows_processed);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '03- After data Insert'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

 

    --Account Level Premium Update

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '04- Before update Account level Premium'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        dbms_output.put_line('--8--');

        MERGE INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details a

        USING (

            SELECT

                b.month_sk,

                b.account_no,

                nvl(SUM((

                    CASE

                        WHEN v_fulldate BETWEEN b.inception_dt AND b.expiration_dt THEN

                            premium_am

                        ELSE

                            0

                    END

                )),

                    0) AS premium_am

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT

                        *

                    FROM

                        (

                            SELECT

                                RANK()

                                OVER(PARTITION BY account_no, policy_no

                                     ORDER BY

                                         account_no, policy_no, inception_dt DESC

                                ) rnk,

                                a.*

                            FROM

                                STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details a

                            WHERE

                                a.month_sk = v_month_sk

                        )

                    WHERE

                        rnk = 1

                ) b

            WHERE

                    month_sk = v_month_sk

                AND active_in = 'Y'

                AND policy_status_tx = 'Active'

            GROUP BY

                month_sk,

                account_no

        ) b ON ( a.account_no = b.account_no

        --Update the account Indicator to Y for 1 year even the Policy Premium is reduced or Cancelled. Need to maintain for 1 year.

        v_sql := 'select B.* from ';

        v_sql := v_sql

                 || '(select * from STAGE_MISREG.STAGE_ACCOUNT_PRM_HIST_DETAILS where month_sk = '

                 || v_prev_month_sk

                 || ') A,';

        v_sql := v_sql

                 || '(select * from STAGE_MISREG.STAGE_ACCOUNT_PRM_HIST_DETAILS where month_sk = '

                 || v_month_sk

                 || ') B ';

        v_sql := v_sql || 'where A.account_no = B.account_no and A.policy_no = B.policy_no and A.inception_dt = B.inception_dt and A.flag = ''Y'' and NVL(DECODE(B.flag,'' '',''N'',B.flag),''N'') <> ''Y'''

        ;

        BEGIN

            OPEN t_acc_pol_validations FOR v_sql;

 

            LOOP

                FETCH t_acc_pol_validations INTO r_acc_pol_validations;

                EXIT WHEN t_acc_pol_validations%notfound;

                IF round(months_between(v_fulldate, r_acc_pol_validations.inception_dt), 2) <= 12.0 THEN

                    v_sql1 := 'UPDATE STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details SET flag = ''Y'' where account_no='

                              || r_acc_pol_validations.account_no

                              || ' and policy_no='''

                              || r_acc_pol_validations.policy_no

                              || ''' and inception_dt='''

                              || to_char(r_acc_pol_validations.inception_dt, 'DD-MON-YYYY')

                              || '''';

 

                    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_sql1;

                    COMMIT;

                END IF;

 

            END LOOP;

 

            CLOSE t_acc_pol_validations;

        EXCEPTION

            WHEN OTHERS THEN

                NULL;

        END;

                SUM(earned_prm_am)      earned_prm_am,

                SUM(itd_earned_prm_am)  itd_earned_prm_am,

                SUM(inforce_prm_am)     inforce_prm_am,

                MAX(inforce_ct)         inforce_ct

            FROM

                tpolicy_summary

            WHERE

                    month_sk = v_month_sk

                AND snapshot_type_in = 0

            GROUP BY

                month_sk,

                policy_sk

        ) b ON ( a.month_sk = b.month_sk

                 AND a.policy_sk = b.policy_sk )

        WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE

        SET a.mtd_written_prm_am = b.mtd_written_prm_am,

            a.ytd_written_prm_am = b.ytd_written_prm_am,

            a.mtd_commission_am = b.mtd_commission_am,

            a.ytd_commission_am = b.ytd_commission_am,

            a.earned_prm_am = b.earned_prm_am,

            a.itd_earned_prm_am = b.itd_earned_prm_am,

            a.inforce_prm_am = b.inforce_prm_am,

            a.inforce_ct = b.inforce_ct

        WHERE

                month_sk = v_month_sk

            AND active_in = 'Y';

 

        COMMIT;

        -----

 

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.tlog_missing_tran_policies

        WHERE

            month_sk = v_month_sk

            OR month_sk IS NULL;

 

        COMMIT;

 

        --Log table to store missing record details (If any)

        dbms_output.put_line('--16--');

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.tlog_missing_tran_policies (

            month_sk,

            policy_sk,

            source_system_nm

        )

            SELECT

                v_month_sk,

                pol.policy_sk,

                pol.source_system_nm

            FROM

                ttransaction t,

                tdate        d,

                tpolicy      pol

            WHERE

                    t.calendar_month_sk = d.date_sk

                AND t.calendar_month_sk <> 0

                AND t.policy_sk = pol.policy_sk

                AND t.calendar_month_sk >= v_yr_begin_dt_sk

                AND pol.inception_dt >= v_yr_begin_act_dt

                AND pol.inception_dt <= v_fulldate + in_future_no_of_days

        --AND td.date_sk = v_month_sk

                AND pol.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 15, 2, 14 )

                AND nvl(pol.uw_co_cd, ' ') NOT IN ( 'AHACC', 'AICC' )

            MINUS

            SELECT

                month_sk,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm

            FROM

                STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

            WHERE

                    month_sk = v_month_sk

                AND active_in = 'Y'

                AND inception_dt >= '01-JAN-2020';

 

        COMMIT;

        dbms_output.put_line('--17--');

        --Log table to store missing record details (If any)

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.tlog_missing_tran_policies (

            month_sk,

            policy_sk,

            source_system_nm

        )

            SELECT

                a.month_sk,

                a.policy_sk,

                b.source_system_nm

            FROM

                tpolicy_summary a,

                tpolicy         b

            WHERE

                    a.policy_sk = b.policy_sk

                AND a.month_sk = v_month_sk

                AND b.inception_dt >= '01-JAN-2020'

                AND b.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 15, 2, 14 )

                AND nvl(b.uw_co_cd, ' ') NOT IN ( 'AHACC', 'AICC' )

            MINUS

            SELECT

                month_sk,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm

            FROM

                STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

            WHERE

                month_sk = v_month_sk;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '05- After Update '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '06- Call to prc_load_actpremium_details '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_load_actpremium_details;

        pk_error_log.pr_log_end_event(v_error_log_sk, v_rows_processed);

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_load_policy_history_manual;

 

    --Lexington Policies

    PROCEDURE prc_load_policy_history_lex (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

 

        v_cnt                     NUMBER;

        v_sql                     VARCHAR2(4000);

        TYPE typ_acc_pol_validations IS REF CURSOR;

        t_acc_pol_validations     typ_acc_pol_validations;

        r_acc_pol_validations     STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet%rowtype;

        v_pol_prm                 tdaily_inforce_policy.annual_premium_am%TYPE;

        v_old_prm                 tdaily_inforce_policy.annual_premium_am%TYPE;

        v_modified_prm_am         STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet.premium_am%TYPE;

        r_gtt_inforce_pol_details STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details%rowtype;

        v_active_policy           BOOLEAN;

        TYPE rec_cancelled_policy_det IS RECORD (

                premium_am             tendorsement.premium_am%TYPE,

                policy_status_tx       tpolicy.policy_status_tx%TYPE,

                previous_pcg_policy_no tpolicy.previous_pcg_policy_no%TYPE,

                reissued_pcg_policy_no tpolicy.reissued_pcg_policy_no%TYPE

        );

        r_cancelled_policy_det    rec_cancelled_policy_det;

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.HISTORY_LEX';

        v_ym := in_ym;

        v_date := sysdate;

        v_rows_processed := 0;

        v_log_params := '(in_YM==>'

                        || v_ym

                        || ');';

        pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

 

    --Get Month SK, Prev Month Sk, month begin SK, END SK (01-JAN, 31-JAN for example) etc.,

        SELECT

            date_sk,

            actual_dt

        INTO

            v_month_sk,

            v_fulldate

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

                year_month_ct = v_ym

            AND month_end_in = 'Y';

 

        SELECT

            date_sk

        INTO v_prev_month_sk

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

                year_month_ct = to_char((add_months(v_fulldate, - 1)),

                                        'yyyymm')

            AND month_end_in = 'Y';

 

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- Delete Data'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet

        WHERE

            month_sk = v_month_sk;

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '02- Before data Insert'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        SELECT

            COUNT(*)

        INTO v_cnt

        FROM

            STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet

        WHERE

                month_sk = v_prev_month_sk

            AND ROWNUM <= 1;

 

        IF v_cnt = 0 THEN

            --Very first time execution insert only Inforce policies till 31-DEC-2019 and

            --Insert all Polcies (Including Cancel/Expired etc., from 01-JAN-2020 for Performance as Indicator is

            --calculated only from 01-JAN-2020

            INSERT  /*+ APPEND */ INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet (

                month_sk,

                account_no,

                policy_no,

                inception_dt,

                premium_am,

                original_premium_am,

                flag,

                active_in,

                zip_cd,

                customer_nm,

                customer_no,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm,

                policy_status_tx

            )

                SELECT

                    v_month_sk,

                    account_no,

                    pol.policy_no,

                    pol.inception_dt,

                    premium_am,

                    premium_am,

                    rpad((

                        CASE

                            WHEN pol.inception_dt >= '01-JAN-2020' THEN

                                'Y'

                            ELSE

                                ' '

                        END

                    ), 1, ' ') flag,

                    'Y',

                    insured_zip_cd,

                    customer_nm,

                    cust.customer_id,

                    pol.policy_sk,

                    pol.source_system_nm,

                    pol.policy_status_tx

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.policy_tran_prmind_details inf,

                    tdate                            td,

                    tcustomer                        cust,

                    tpolicy                          pol

                WHERE

                        inf.customer_sk = cust.customer_sk

                    AND inf.date_sk = td.date_sk

                    AND pol.policy_sk = inf.policy_sk

                    AND td.date_sk = v_month_sk

                    AND pol.source_system_sk IN ( 15 );

 

            v_rows_processed := SQL%rowcount;

            COMMIT;

        ELSE

            --Copy previous month data into current month with flag as Inactive and later make it active looping each policy for validations.

            INSERT  /*+ APPEND */ INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet (

                month_sk,

                account_no,

                policy_no,

                inception_dt,

                premium_am,

                original_premium_am,

                flag,

                active_in,

                zip_cd,

                customer_nm,

                customer_no,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm,

                policy_status_tx

            )

                SELECT

                    v_month_sk,

                    account_no,

                    policy_no,

                    inception_dt,

                    premium_am,

                    original_premium_am,

                    flag,

                    (

                        CASE

                            WHEN to_char(inception_dt, 'YYYY') = to_char(v_yr_begin_act_dt, 'YYYY') THEN

                                'N'

                            ELSE

                                'Y'

                        END

                    ) active_in,

                    zip_cd,

                    customer_nm,

                    customer_no,

                    policy_sk,

                    source_system_nm,

                    policy_status_tx

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet

                WHERE

                        month_sk = v_prev_month_sk

                    AND active_in = 'Y';

 

            COMMIT;

 

            --Insert the current active policies into GTT table.

            INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details (

                month_sk,

                account_no,

                policy_no,

                inception_dt,

                premium_am,

                zip_cd,

                customer_nm,

                customer_no,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm,

                policy_status_tx

            )

                SELECT

                    v_month_sk,

                    account_no,

                    pol.policy_no,

                    pol.inception_dt,

                    premium_am,

                    zip_cd,

                    customer_nm,

                    cust.customer_id,

                    pol.policy_sk,

                    pol.source_system_nm,

                    pol.policy_status_tx

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.policy_tran_prmind_details inf,

                    tdate                            td,

                    tcustomer                        cust,

                    tpolicy                          pol

                WHERE

                        inf.customer_sk = cust.customer_sk

                    AND inf.date_sk = td.date_sk

                    AND pol.policy_sk = inf.policy_sk

                    AND td.date_sk = v_month_sk

                    AND pol.source_system_sk IN ( 15 );

 

            COMMIT;

 

        --Account level Insert not required as Lexington never store Account_no in the Table.

 

            --Insert updated inception_dt and other details if incept_dt 1 year period is over.

            ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

            --Loop through each record policy, inception and check Inception is expired. If so, Add new Policy # and updated inception, premkium etc.,

            v_sql := 'select * from STAGE_MISREG.STAGE_ACCOUNT_PRM_HIST_LEXDET where month_sk='

                     || v_month_sk

                     || ' and active_in=''N'' order by policy_no';

            OPEN t_acc_pol_validations FOR v_sql;

 

            LOOP

                FETCH t_acc_pol_validations INTO r_acc_pol_validations;

                EXIT WHEN t_acc_pol_validations%notfound;

 

                --Check if policy one year is over based on Inception_dt and insert latest data into History table

                IF round(months_between(v_fulldate, r_acc_pol_validations.inception_dt), 2) > 12.0 THEN

                    --Insert a new row from tpolicy with latest premium amount

                    --------------------------------------------------------------

                    --When policy expired, update Premium with premium as on expiry, update Indicator and make it Active record as

                    --User wants to see past records too.

                    BEGIN

                        SELECT

                            premium_am

                        INTO v_old_prm

                        FROM

                            STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet

                        WHERE

                                month_sk = v_prev_month_sk

                            AND policy_no = r_acc_pol_validations.policy_no

                            AND inception_dt = r_acc_pol_validations.inception_dt;

 

                    EXCEPTION

                        WHEN OTHERS THEN

                            v_old_prm := 0;

                    END;

 

                    UPDATE STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet

                    SET

                        premium_am = v_old_prm,

                        original_premium_am = v_old_prm,

                        active_in = 'Y'

                    WHERE

                            month_sk = v_month_sk

                        AND policy_no = r_acc_pol_validations.policy_no

                        AND inception_dt = r_acc_pol_validations.inception_dt;

 

                    v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

                    COMMIT;

                    INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet (

                        month_sk,

                        account_no,

                        policy_no,

                        inception_dt,

                        premium_am,

                        original_premium_am,

                        flag,

                        active_in,

                        zip_cd,

                        customer_nm,

                        customer_no,

                        policy_sk,

                        source_system_nm,

                        policy_status_tx

                    )

                        SELECT

                            month_sk,

                            account_no,

                            policy_no,

                            inception_dt,

                            premium_am,

                            premium_am,

                            rpad((

                                CASE

                                    WHEN inception_dt >= '01-JAN-2020' THEN

                                        'Y'

                                    ELSE

                                        ' '

                                END

                            ), 1, ' ') flag,

                            'Y',

                            zip_cd,

                            customer_nm,

                            customer_no,

                            policy_sk,

                            source_system_nm,

                            policy_status_tx

                        FROM

                            STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details a

                        WHERE

                                policy_no = r_acc_pol_validations.policy_no

                            AND NOT EXISTS (

                                SELECT

                                    1

                                FROM

                                    STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet b

                                WHERE

                                        a.month_sk = b.month_sk

                                    AND a.policy_no = b.policy_no

                                    AND a.inception_dt = b.inception_dt

                            );

 

                --select * INTO r_pol_details from tpolicy where policy_no=

                ELSE

                    --Insert records with modified Primum_am in Prmimum_am column and old premium in original_premium_am column.

                    v_active_policy := FALSE;

                    BEGIN

                        --If policy is active - update the premium accordingly and make it active.

                        SELECT

                            *

                        INTO r_gtt_inforce_pol_details

                        FROM

                            STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details

                        WHERE

                                policy_no = r_acc_pol_validations.policy_no

                            AND inception_dt = r_acc_pol_validations.inception_dt;

 

                        v_active_policy := TRUE;

                    EXCEPTION

                        WHEN OTHERS THEN

                            v_active_policy := FALSE;

                    END;

 

                    IF v_active_policy = true THEN

                        UPDATE STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet

                        SET

                            premium_am = r_gtt_inforce_pol_details.premium_am,

                            active_in = 'Y'

                        WHERE

                                policy_no = r_acc_pol_validations.policy_no

                            AND inception_dt = r_acc_pol_validations.inception_dt

                            AND month_sk = v_month_sk;

 

                        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

                        COMMIT;

                    ELSE

                        v_active_policy := FALSE;

 

                        --If policy is cancelled and Inactive After last month

                        BEGIN

                            SELECT

                                tend.premium_am,

                                tpol.policy_status_tx,

                                tpol.previous_pcg_policy_no,

                                tpol.reissued_pcg_policy_no

                            INTO

                                r_cancelled_policy_det.premium_am,

                                r_cancelled_policy_det.policy_status_tx,

                                r_cancelled_policy_det.previous_pcg_policy_no,

                                r_cancelled_policy_det.reissued_pcg_policy_no

                            FROM

                                tendorsement tend,

                                tpolicy      tpol

                            WHERE

                                    tend.policy_sk = tpol.policy_sk

                                AND tend.endorsement_no = (

                                    SELECT

                                        MAX(tend1.endorsement_no)

                                    FROM

                                        tendorsement tend1

                                    WHERE

                                        tend.policy_sk = tend1.policy_sk

                                )

                                AND tpol.policy_no = r_acc_pol_validations.policy_no

                                AND tpol.inception_dt = r_acc_pol_validations.inception_dt;

 

                            v_active_policy := TRUE;

                        EXCEPTION

                            WHEN OTHERS THEN

                                v_active_policy := FALSE;

                        END;

 

                        IF v_active_policy = true THEN

                            IF r_cancelled_policy_det.policy_status_tx = 'Cancelled' THEN

                                UPDATE STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet

                                SET

                                    premium_am = - ( r_cancelled_policy_det.premium_am ), --Update with Negative premium if cancelled

                                    active_in = 'Y'

                                WHERE

                                        policy_no = r_acc_pol_validations.policy_no

                                    AND inception_dt = r_acc_pol_validations.inception_dt

                                    AND month_sk = v_month_sk;

 

                                v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

                                COMMIT;

                            ELSIF r_cancelled_policy_det.policy_status_tx = 'Active' THEN --Incase if the above active_policy=True missed to capture the record.. otherwise this section will never be executed.

                                UPDATE STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet

                                SET

                                    premium_am = r_cancelled_policy_det.premium_am, --Update actual premium if Active

                                    active_in = 'Y'

                                WHERE

                                        policy_no = r_acc_pol_validations.policy_no

                                    AND inception_dt = r_acc_pol_validations.inception_dt

                                    AND month_sk = v_month_sk;

 

                                v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

                                COMMIT;

                            ELSE            --Incase renewed in another policy

                                --if its renewed to another policy

                                NULL; --This will be taken care in the Insert statement after the Loop. Check section "Insert any new policies got added on existing account."

                            END IF;

                        END IF;

 

                    END IF;

 

                END IF;

            --Check the policy is still Active and premium Not changed and Inception_dt 1 year not over.

            END LOOP;

 

            CLOSE t_acc_pol_validations;

        END IF;

 

        --Insert any new policies got added on existing account.

        INSERT  /*+ APPEND */ INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet (

            month_sk,

            account_no,

            policy_no,

            inception_dt,

            premium_am,

            original_premium_am,

            flag,

            active_in,

            zip_cd,

            customer_nm,

            customer_no,

            policy_sk,

            source_system_nm,

            policy_status_tx

        )

            SELECT

                month_sk,

                account_no,

                policy_no,

                inception_dt,

                premium_am,

                0,

                rpad((

                    CASE

                        WHEN inception_dt >= '01-JAN-2020' THEN

                            'Y'

                        ELSE

                            ' '

                    END

                ), 1, ' ') flag,

                'Y',

                zip_cd,

                customer_nm, --To be checked and Modify how to not attach in treaty file.

                customer_no,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm,

                policy_status_tx

            FROM

                STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details

            WHERE

                ( policy_no, inception_dt ) IN (

                    SELECT

                        policy_no, inception_dt

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details

                    MINUS

                    SELECT

                        policy_no, inception_dt

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet

                    WHERE

                        month_sk = v_month_sk

                );

 

        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        v_log_params := v_module_name

                        || ' - '

                        || to_char(v_rows_processed);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '03- After data Insert'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

 

        --Log table missing record details

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.tlog_missing_tran_policies (

            month_sk,

            policy_sk,

            source_system_nm

        )

            SELECT

                v_month_sk,

                pol.policy_sk,

                pol.source_system_nm

            FROM

                ttransaction t,

                tdate        d,

                tpolicy      pol

            WHERE

                    t.calendar_month_sk = d.date_sk

                AND t.calendar_month_sk <> 0

                AND t.policy_sk = pol.policy_sk

                AND pol.inception_dt >= v_yr_begin_act_dt

                AND t.calendar_month_sk >= v_yr_begin_dt_sk

                AND pol.source_system_sk IN ( 15 )

            MINUS

            SELECT

                month_sk,

                policy_sk,

                source_system_nm

            FROM

                STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet

            WHERE

                month_sk = v_month_sk;

 

        COMMIT;

        pk_error_log.pr_log_end_event(v_error_log_sk, v_rows_processed);

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_load_policy_history_lex;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_premium_feed_load (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.MANUAL_PRM';

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- Begin P1'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stage_premium_feed_details

        WHERE

            param_num = in_ym;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_premium_feed_details (

            fiserv_premium_record,

            param_num,

            load_timestamp

        )

            SELECT

                *

            FROM

                (

                    WITH main_qry AS (

                        SELECT

                            rpad(' ', 15, ' ')               AS "Primary-Package-ID",

                            rpad(' ', 15, ' ')               AS "Secondary-Package-ID",

                            rpad(a.policy_no, 15, ' ')       AS "POLICY-NUMBER",

                            rpad(decode(b.wins_uw_cd,

                                        NULL,

                                        ' ',

                                        substr(b.wins_uw_cd, 3, 2)),

                                 2,

                                 ' ')                        AS "COMPANY-NUM",

                            rpad(' ', 2, ' ')                AS "MODULE-NUM",

                            rpad(' ', 3, ' ')                AS "UNIT-NUM",

                            rpad(to_char(h.actual_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                 10,

                                 ' ')                        AS "COVERAGE-EFFECTIVE",

                            rpad(to_char(a.inception_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                 10,

                                 ' ')                        AS "POLICY-EFFECTIVE",

                            rpad(' ', 2, ' ')                AS "CLIENT-FILLER1",

                            'P'                              AS "RECORD-TYPE",

                            rpad(to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                 10,

                                 ' ')                        AS "ENTRY-DATE",

                            rpad(' ', 1, ' ')                AS "PACKAGE-POLICY-IND",

                            rpad(decode(a.risk_state_cd, NULL, ' ', a.risk_state_cd),

                                 2,

                                 ' ')                        AS "POLICY-STATE",

                            rpad(' ', 46, ' ')               AS "FISERV-FILLER1",

                            rpad(' ', 40, ' ')               AS "CLIENT-FILLER2",

                            rpad(' ', 10, ' ')               AS "CLIENT-FILLER3",

                            rpad(to_char(a.expiration_dt - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                 10,

                                 ' ')                        AS "EXPIRATION-DATE",

                            rpad(a.broker_id, 15, ' ')       AS "AGENCY-NUM",

                            rpad(' ', 3, ' ')                AS "MAJOR-PERIL",

                            || TRIM(to_char(abs(c.premium_am - nvl(c.tax_fee_srchrg_am, 0)),

                                            '0000000000000.00'))             AS "INFORCE-PREM",

                            '+0000000000000.00'              AS "EARNED-PREM",

                            CASE

                                WHEN c.premium_am < 0 THEN

                                        '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                            || TRIM(to_char(abs(c.premium_am - nvl(c.tax_fee_srchrg_am, 0)),

                                            '0000000000000.00'))             AS "CURRENT-UNEARNED-PREM",

                            '+0000000000000.00'              AS "PREVIOUS-UNEARNED-PREM",

                            '+0000000000000.00'              AS "FAC-WRITTEN-PREM",

                            '+0000000000000.00'              AS "FAC-COMMISSION",

                            '+0000000000000.00'              AS "COLLECTED-PREM",

                            '+0000000000000.00'              AS "DIRECT-COMMISSION",

                            '+0000000000000.00'              AS "COLLECTED-PREM-COMMISSION",

                            '+0000000000000.00'              AS "COLLECTED-PREM-OVERRIDE"                           --,

               --C.YEAR_MONTH_CT

               --    AS "ACCT MONTH"

                        FROM

                                 (

                                SELECT  /*+INDEX(T1 IDX_TTRANSACTION_ACCT_DT)*/

                                    t1.endorsement_no,

                                    SUM(t1.premium_am)     AS premium_am,

                                    SUM(tax_fee_srchrg_am) AS tax_fee_srchrg_am,

                                    policy_sk,

                                    coverage_sk,

                                    tran_type_sk,

                                    transaction_dt_sk,

                                    accounting_dt_sk,

                                    effective_dt_sk,

                                    t2.year_month_ct

                                FROM

                                    ttransaction t1,

                                    tdate        t2

                                WHERE

                                        t1.accounting_dt_sk = t2.date_sk

                                    AND t2.year_month_ct = in_ym

                                    AND ( t1.premium_am <> 0

                                          OR t1.taxfeesurcharge_sk = 3 )

                                GROUP BY

                                    t1.endorsement_no,

                                    policy_sk,

                                    coverage_sk,

                                    tran_type_sk,

                                    transaction_dt_sk,

                                    accounting_dt_sk,

                                    effective_dt_sk,

                                    t2.year_month_ct

                            ) c

                            JOIN tpolicy             a ON c.policy_sk = a.policy_sk

                            LEFT JOIN tcustomer           tc ON tc.customer_id = a.customer_id

                            LEFT JOIN tcoverage           g ON c.coverage_sk = g.coverage_sk

                            LEFT JOIN tpolicy_type        m ON TRIM(a.policy_type_cd) = TRIM(m.policy_type_cd)

                            LEFT JOIN tpim_coverage       j ON c.coverage_sk = j.pim_coverage_sk

                            LEFT JOIN tpel_coverage       k ON c.coverage_sk = k.pel_coverage_sk

                            LEFT JOIN ttransaction_type   l ON c.tran_type_sk = l.tran_type_sk

                            JOIN tuw_company         b ON TRIM(b.uw_co_cd_1) = TRIM(a.uw_co_cd)

                            LEFT JOIN trisk_state_country n ON a.risk_state_country_sk = n.risk_state_country_sk

                            JOIN tdate               e ON e.date_sk = c.transaction_dt_sk

                            JOIN tdate               f ON f.date_sk = c.accounting_dt_sk

                            JOIN tdate               h ON h.date_sk = c.effective_dt_sk

                            LEFT JOIN tprocessing_office  po ON TRIM(a.uw_center_nm) = TRIM(po.processing_office_desc_tx)

                                                               AND TRIM(substr(b.wins_uw_cd, 3, 2)) NOT IN ( '51', '61' )

                                                               AND TRIM(n.risk_country_nm) <> 'CANADA'

                        WHERE

                            ( ( a.source_system_nm IN ( 'Manual', 'Program Connect' )

                                AND a.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 2, 14 )

                                AND TRIM(a.policy_type_cd) IN ( 'EPLI', 'EQ', 'EXFL', 'GRX', 'PC' ) ) --NOT IN ('HO','YHT','AV','WC')

                              OR ( a.source_system_nm = 'AIWCS'

                                   AND TRIM(a.policy_type_cd) = 'WC' ) )

                            AND c.premium_am <> 0

                    ), acc_prm AS (

                        SELECT

                            rpad(nvl(account_no, ' '),

                                 10,

                                 ' ')                "AIG-ACCOUNT#_B",

                            rpad(nvl(flag, ' '),

                                 1,

                                 ' ')                "AIG_ACCT_GT_10K",

                            rpad(policy_no, 15, ' ') AS "POLICY-NUMBER_B",

                            rpad(to_char(inception_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                 10,

                                 ' ')                AS "POLICY-EFFECTIVE_B"

                        FROM

                            STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details aph,

                            tdate                                td

                        WHERE

                                aph.month_sk = td.date_sk

                            AND td.actual_dt IN (

                                SELECT

                                    actual_dt

                                FROM

                                    tdate

                                WHERE

                                    year_month_ct = in_ym

                            )

                            AND active_in = 'Y'

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT

                            rpad(nvl(account_no, ' '),

                                 10,

                                 ' ')                "AIG-ACCOUNT#_B",

                            rpad(nvl(flag, ' '),

                                 1,

                                 ' ')                "AIG_ACCT_GT_10K",

                            rpad(policy_no, 15, ' ') AS "POLICY-NUMBER_B",

                            rpad(to_char(inception_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                 10,

                                 ' ')                AS "POLICY-EFFECTIVE_B"

                        FROM

                            STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_lexdet aph,

                            tdate                               td

                        WHERE

                                aph.month_sk = td.date_sk

                            AND td.actual_dt IN (

                                SELECT

                                    actual_dt

                                FROM

                                    tdate

                                WHERE

                                    year_month_ct = in_ym

                            )

                            AND active_in = 'Y'

                    )

                    SELECT

                        "Primary-Package-ID"

                        || "Secondary-Package-ID"

                        || "POLICY-NUMBER"

                        || "COMPANY-NUM"

                        || "MODULE-NUM"

                        || "UNIT-NUM"

                        || "COVERAGE-EFFECTIVE"

                        || "POLICY-EFFECTIVE"

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER1"

                        || "RECORD-TYPE"

                        || "ENTRY-DATE"

                        || "PACKAGE-POLICY-IND"

                        || "POLICY-STATE"

                        || "FISERV-FILLER1"

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER2"

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER3"

                        || "EXPIRATION-DATE"

                        || "AGENCY-NUM"

                        || "MAJOR-PERIL"

                        || "SEQUENCE-NUM"

                        || "LINE-OF-BUSINESS"

                        || "CLAIMANT"

                        || "FISERVE-FILLER2"

                        || "AIG-PRODUCT"

                        || "AIG-SUB-LINE"

                        || "AIG-INTERNAL-COVERAGE"

                        || "AIG-LOCATION"

                        || "AIG-POLICY-LIMIT"

                        || "AIG-ISO-CLASS-CODE"

                        || "AIG-LOSS-CODE"

                        || "AIG-NEW-CLAIM-IND"

                        || "AIG-LOSS-TRANS-CODE"

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER4_1"

                        || nvl("AIG_ACCT_GT_10K", ' ')

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER4_2"

                        || "STATUTORY-CO-ORIG"

                        || "CONTRACT-ASMD"

                        || "STATUTORY-CO-ASMD"

                        || "BOOKED-DATE"

                        || "STATUS-CODE"

                        || "EXPOSURE-AMOUNT"

                        || "SURPLUS-LINES"

                        || "PROCESSING-DATE"

                        || "BUSINESS-TYPE"

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER5"

                        || "URS-TREATY-NUM"

                        || "URS-TREATY-COMPANY"

                        || "URS-CLAIM-NUM"

                        || "URS-RETRO-NUM"

                        || "FAC-CERTIFICATE"

                        || "RISK-STATE"

                        || "FAC-BROKER-NUM"

                        || "INSURED-NAME"

                        || "FISERVE-FILLER3"

                        || "FILE-SOURCE-INDICATOR"

                        || "AIG-BRANCH-CODE"

                        || "AIG-COUNTRY-CODE"

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER6_1"

                        || nvl("AIG-ACCOUNT#_B", "AIG-ACCOUNT#_A")

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER6_2"

                        || "FISERV-FILLER4"

                        || "AIG-PREMIUM-TRANS-CD"

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER7"

                        || "FAC-RECORD-INDICATOR"

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER8"

                        || "ACCOUNT-DATE"

                        || "REINSURANCE-TYPE"

                        || "CONTRACT-PLACEMENT-PERCENT"

                        || "CONTRACT-EXPERIENCE-DATE"

                        || "UPR-FORMULA-CODE"

                        || "INSTALLMENT-TREATY-IND"

                        || "PREM-PORT-TRANS-IND"

                        || "CLIENT-FILLER9"

                        || "DIRECT-COMMISSION-PCT"

                        || "INITIAL-BALANCE-IND"

                        || "FISERV-FILLER5"

                        || "COMMISSION"

                        || "BROKERAGE"

                        || "OVERRIDE"

                        || "WRITTEN-PREM"

                        || "INFORCE-PREM"

                        || "EARNED-PREM"

                        || "CURRENT-UNEARNED-PREM"

                        || "PREVIOUS-UNEARNED-PREM"

                        || "FAC-WRITTEN-PREM"

                        || "FAC-COMMISSION"

                        || "COLLECTED-PREM"

                        || "DIRECT-COMMISSION"

                        || "COLLECTED-PREM-COMMISSION"

                        || "COLLECTED-PREM-OVERRIDE" AS "FISERV PREMIUM RECORD",

                        in_ym,

                        systimestamp

                    FROM

                        main_qry a

                        LEFT OUTER JOIN acc_prm  b ON rtrim("POLICY-NUMBER") = rtrim("POLICY-NUMBER_B")

                                                     AND rtrim("POLICY-EFFECTIVE") = rtrim("POLICY-EFFECTIVE_B")

                                                                                               AND rtrim("AIG-ACCOUNT#_A") = rtrim("AIG-ACCOUNT#_B") ---Krishnan [22 Aug 2025] - US728006 - Change made to ensure duplicate account numbers are not loaded.

                );

 

        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- End P2'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_premium_feed_load;

                );

        COMMIT;

            RAISE;

    END prc_claims_feed_load;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_premium_control_load (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.MANUAL_CONTROL';

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- Begin P4'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stage_premium_control_details

        WHERE

            param_num = in_ym;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_premium_control_details (

            fiserv_premium_record,

            param_num,

            load_timestamp

        )

            SELECT

                *

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT

                        "AIG-PRODUCT"

                        || "PE-WRITTEN-PREM"

                        || "PE-WRITTEN-PREM-COUNT"

                        || "HOP80-WRITTEN-PREM"

                        || "HOP80-WRITTEN-PREM-COUNT"

                        || "HOP20-WRITTEN-PREM"

                        || "HOP20-WRITTEN-PREM-COUNT"

                        || "YIP80-WRITTEN-PREM"

                        || "YIP80-WRITTEN-PREM-COUNT"

                        || "YIP20-WRITTEN-PREM"

                        || "YIP20-WRITTEN-PREM-COUNT"

                        || "ALL-WRITTEN-PREM"

                        || "ALL-WRITTEN-PREM-COUNT",

                        in_ym,

                        systimestamp

                    FROM

                        (

                            SELECT

                                "AIG-PRODUCT",

                                CASE

                                    WHEN SUM("PE-WRITTEN-PREM") < 0 THEN

                                            '-'

                                    ELSE

                                        '+'

                                END

                                || TRIM(to_char(abs(SUM("PE-WRITTEN-PREM")),

                                                '0000000000000.00')) AS "PE-WRITTEN-PREM",

                                CASE

                                    WHEN SUM("PE-WRITTEN-PREM-COUNT") < 0 THEN

                                            '-'

                                    ELSE

                                        '+'

                                                '00000.00'))         AS "PE-WRITTEN-PREM-COUNT",

                                            '-'

                                        '+'

                                    WHEN SUM("HOP80-WRITTEN-PREM-COUNT") < 0 THEN

                                CASE

                                            '-'

                                    ELSE

                                        '+'

                                        '+'

                                    WHEN SUM("ALL-WRITTEN-PREM") < 0 THEN

                                            '-'

                                    ELSE

                                        '+'
