                                                LEFT JOIN trisk_state_country n ON a.risk_state_country_sk = n.risk_state_country_sk

                                                JOIN tdate               e ON e.date_sk = c.transaction_dt_sk

                                                JOIN tdate               f ON f.date_sk = c.accounting_dt_sk

                                                JOIN tdate               h ON h.date_sk = c.effective_dt_sk

                                                LEFT JOIN tprocessing_office  po ON TRIM(a.uw_center_nm) = TRIM(po.processing_office_desc_tx

                                                )

                                                a.source_system_nm IN ( 'Manual', 'Program Connect' )

                                                AND a.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 2, 14 )

                                                    SELECT

                                                rpad(' ', 1, ' ')                AS "INSTALLMENT-TREATY-IND",

                                                rpad(' ', 1, ' ')                AS "PREM-PORT-TRANS-IND",

                                                rpad(' ', 26, ' ')               AS "CLIENT-FILLER9",

                                                '+000.000000'                    AS "DIRECT-COMMISSION-PCT",

                                                rpad(' ', 1, ' ')                AS "INITIAL-BALANCE-IND",

                                                rpad(' ', 24, ' ')               AS "FISERV-FILLER5",

                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "COMMISSION",

                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "BROKERAGE",

                                                END

                                                                '0000000000000.00'))             AS "WRITTEN-PREM",

                                                CASE

                                                    WHEN c.premium_am < 0 THEN

                                                            '-'

                                                    ELSE

                                                        '+'

                                                END

                                                || TRIM(to_char(abs(c.premium_am - nvl(c.tax_fee_srchrg_am, 0)),

                                                                '0000000000000.00'))             AS "INFORCE-PREM",

                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "EARNED-PREM",

                                                CASE

                                                    WHEN c.premium_am < 0 THEN

                                                            '-'

                                                    ELSE

                                                        '+'

                                                END

                                                || TRIM(to_char(abs(c.premium_am - nvl(c.tax_fee_srchrg_am, 0)),

                                                                '0000000000000.00'))             AS "CURRENT-UNEARNED-PREM",

                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "PREVIOUS-UNEARNED-PREM",

                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "FAC-WRITTEN-PREM",

                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "FAC-COMMISSION",

                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "COLLECTED-PREM",

                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "DIRECT-COMMISSION",

                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "COLLECTED-PREM-COMMISSION",

                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "COLLECTED-PREM-OVERRIDE",

                                                c.year_month_ct                  AS "ACCT MONTH"

                                            FROM

                                                     (

                                                    SELECT  /*+INDEX(T1 IDX_TTRANSACTION_ACCT_DT)*/

                                                        t1.endorsement_no,

                                                        SUM(t1.premium_am)     AS premium_am,

                                                        SUM(tax_fee_srchrg_am) AS tax_fee_srchrg_am,

                                                        policy_sk,

                                                        coverage_sk,

                                                        tran_type_sk,

                                                        transaction_dt_sk,

                                                        accounting_dt_sk,

                                                        effective_dt_sk,

                                                        t2.year_month_ct

                                                    FROM

                                                        ttransaction t1,

                                                        tdate        t2

                                                    WHERE

                                                            t1.accounting_dt_sk = t2.date_sk

                                                        AND t2.year_month_ct = in_ym

                                                        AND ( t1.premium_am <> 0

                                                              OR t1.taxfeesurcharge_sk = 3 )

                                                    GROUP BY

                                                        t1.endorsement_no,

                                                        policy_sk,

                                                        coverage_sk,

                                                        tran_type_sk,

                                                        transaction_dt_sk,

                                                        accounting_dt_sk,

                                                        effective_dt_sk,

                                                        t2.year_month_ct

                                                ) c

                                                JOIN tpolicy             a ON c.policy_sk = a.policy_sk

                                                LEFT JOIN tcoverage           g ON c.coverage_sk = g.coverage_sk

                                                LEFT JOIN tpolicy_type        m ON TRIM(a.policy_type_cd) = TRIM(m.policy_type_cd)

                                                LEFT JOIN tpim_coverage       j ON c.coverage_sk = j.pim_coverage_sk

                                                LEFT JOIN tpel_coverage       k ON c.coverage_sk = k.pel_coverage_sk

                                                LEFT JOIN ttransaction_type   l ON c.tran_type_sk = l.tran_type_sk

                                                JOIN tuw_company         b ON TRIM(b.uw_co_cd_1) = TRIM(a.uw_co_cd)

                                                LEFT JOIN trisk_state_country n ON a.risk_state_country_sk = n.risk_state_country_sk

                                                JOIN tdate               e ON e.date_sk = c.transaction_dt_sk

                                                JOIN tdate               f ON f.date_sk = c.accounting_dt_sk

                                                JOIN tdate               h ON h.date_sk = c.effective_dt_sk

                                                LEFT JOIN tprocessing_office  po ON TRIM(a.uw_center_nm) = TRIM(po.processing_office_desc_tx

                                                )

                                                                                   AND TRIM(substr(b.wins_uw_cd, 3, 2)) NOT IN ( '51'

                                                                                   , '61' )

                                                                                   AND TRIM(n.risk_country_nm) <> 'CANADA'

                                            WHERE

                                                ( ( a.source_system_nm IN ( 'Manual', 'Program Connect' )

                                                    AND a.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 2, 14 )

                                                    AND TRIM(a.policy_type_cd) IN ( 'EPLI', 'EQ', 'EXFL', 'GRX', 'PC' ) ) --NOT IN ('HO','YHT','AV','WC')

                                                  OR ( a.source_system_nm = 'AIWCS'

                                                       AND TRIM(a.policy_type_cd) = 'WC' ) )

                                                AND c.premium_am <> 0

                                        )

                                    GROUP BY

                                        "AIG-PRODUCT"

                                )

                            GROUP BY

                                "AIG-PRODUCT"

                        )

                );

 

        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- End P4'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_premium_control_load;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_claims_control_load (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.MANUAL_CLAIMS_CONTROL';

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- Begin P5'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stage_loss_control_details

        WHERE

            param_num = in_ym;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_loss_control_details (

            fiserv_loss_record,

            param_num,

            load_timestamp

        )

            SELECT

                *

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT

                        "AIG-PRODUCT"

                        || "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LOSS"

                        || "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LOSS-COUNT"

                        || "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE1"

                        || "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE1-COUNT"

                        || "SALVAGE-LOSS"

                        || "SUBRO-LOSS"

                        || "SALVAGE-SUBRO-LOSS-COUNT"

                                                                            e.loss_state_cd,

                                                                            a.risk_state_cd),

                                                                     2,

                                                                     ' ')                        AS "RISK-STATE",

                                                                rpad(' ', 5, ' ')                AS "FAC-BROKER-NUM",

                                                                rpad(decode(a.insured_nm, NULL, ' ', a.insured_nm, a.insured_nm),

                                                                     30,

                                                                     ' ')                        AS "INSURED-NAME",

                                                                rpad(' ', 30, ' ')               AS "FISERVE-FILLER3",

                                                                'M'                              AS "FILE-SOURCE-INDICATOR",

                                                                rpad(decode(po.wins_office_cd,

                                                                            NULL,

                                                                            '75',

                                                                            substr(po.wins_office_cd, 1, 2)),

                                                                     2,

                                                                     ' ')                        AS "AIG-BRANCH-CODE",

                                                                rpad(decode(n.risk_country_wins_cd, NULL, 'USA', n.risk_country_wins_cd

                                                                ),

                                                                     3,

                                                                     ' ')                        AS "AIG-COUNTRY-CODE",

                                                                rpad(' ', 44, ' ')               AS "CLIENT-FILLER7",

                                                                rpad(' ', 50, ' ')               AS "FISERV-FILLER4",

                                                                rpad(' ', 30, ' ')               AS "CLIENT-FILLER8",

                                                                rpad(to_char(d.report_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                                                     10,

                                                                     ' ')                        AS "REPORTED-DATE",

                                                                rpad(' ', 3, ' ')                AS "CAUSE-OF-LOSS",

                                                                rpad(decode(TRIM(d.catastrophe_cd),

                                                                            'N/A',

                                                                            ' ',

                                                                            to_char(d.loss_dt, 'YY')

                                                                            || substr(TRIM(d.catastrophe_cd),

                                                                                      3,

                                                                     4,

                                                                rpad(decode(e.claimant_nm, NULL, ' ', e.claimant_nm, e.claimant_nm),

                                                                rpad(' ', 29, ' ')               AS "FISERV-FILLER5",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE4",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE5",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE6",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE7",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE8",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "CURRENT-CYCLE-SALVAGE-LOSS",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "CURRENT-CYCLE-SALVAGE-LAE",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "CURRENT-CYCLE-SUBRO-LOSS",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "CURRENT-CYCLE-SUBRO-LAE",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-PAID-LOSS",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-PAID-LAE1",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-PAID-LAE2",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-PAID-LAE3",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-PAID-LAE4",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-PAID-LAE5",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-PAID-LAE6",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-PAID-LAE7",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-PAID-LAE8",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-SALVAGE-LAE",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "ITD-SUBRO-LAE",

                                                                l.loss_reserve_am                AS "OS-LOSS1",

                                                                l.expense_reserve_am             AS "OS-LAE-11",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "OS-LAE-2",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "INCURRED-LOSS",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "INCURRED-LAE",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "RESERVE-CREDIT",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "FISERV-FUTURE-AMOUNT-1",

                                                                '+0000000000000.00'              AS "FISERV-FUTURE-AMOUNT-2"

                                                                    SELECT

                                                                        t3.*

                                                                    FROM

                                                                        tdate              t4

                                                                        ( t3.loss_reserve_am <> 0

                                                                          OR t3.expense_reserve_am <> 0 )

                                                                        AND t3.transaction_dt_sk = t4.date_sk

                                                                        AND t4.month_acctng_ct <= in_ym

                                                                ) l

                                                                JOIN tclaim              d ON d.claim_sk = l.claim_sk

                                                                JOIN tpolicy             a ON a.policy_sk = d.policy_sk

                                                                JOIN tclaim_features     e ON l.claim_feature_sk = e.claim_feature_sk

                                                                LEFT JOIN ttransaction_type   m ON l.tran_type_sk = m.tran_type_sk

                                                                LEFT JOIN tuw_company         b ON TRIM(a.uw_co_cd) = TRIM(b.uw_co_cd_1

                                                                )

                                                                LEFT JOIN tlosstype           k ON d.loss_type_sk = k.loss_type_sk

                                                                LEFT JOIN tpolicy_type        g ON TRIM(a.policy_type_cd) = TRIM(g.policy_type_cd

                                                                )

                                                                LEFT JOIN tpim_coverage       h ON l.coverage_sk = h.pim_coverage_sk

                                                                LEFT JOIN tcoverage           i ON l.coverage_sk = i.coverage_sk

                                                                LEFT JOIN trisk_state_country n ON a.risk_state_country_sk = n.risk_state_country_sk

                                                                LEFT JOIN tprocessing_office  po ON TRIM(a.uw_center_nm) = TRIM(po.processing_office_desc_tx

                                                                )

                                                            WHERE

                                                                    TRIM(g.policy_type_cd) <> 'HP'

                                                                AND TRIM(substr(b.wins_uw_cd, 3, 2)) NOT IN ( '51', '61' )

                                                                AND l.source_system_sk IN ( 6, 7, 15 )

                                                        )

                                                    GROUP BY

                                                        "Primary-Package-ID",

                                                        "Secondary-Package-ID",

                                                        "POLICY-NUMBER",

                                                        "COMPANY-NUM",

                                                        "MODULE-NUM",

                                                        "CLAIM-OFFICE",

                                                        "CLAIM-NUM",

                                                        "FISERV-FILLER1",

                                                        "CLIENT-FILLER2",

                                                        "AGENCY-NUM",

                                                        "MAJOR-PERIL",

                                                        "LINE-OF-BUSINESS",

                                                        "CLAIMANT",

                                                        "FISERV-FILLER2",

                                                        "AIG-PRODUCT",

                                                        "AIG-SUB-LINE",

                                                        "AIG-INTERNAL-COVERAGE",

                                                        "AIG-LOCATION",

                                                        "CLIENT-FILLER4",

                                                        "AIG-ISO-CLASS-CODE",

                                                        "AIG-LOSS-CODE",

                                                        "AIG-NEW-CLAIM-INDICATOR",

                                                        "AIG-LOSS-TRANS-CODE",

                                                        "CLIENT-FILLER5",

                                                        "STATUTORY-CO-ORIG",

                                                        "CONTRACT-ASMD",

                                                        "STATUTORY-CO-ASMD",

                                                        "BOOKED-DATE",

                                                        "STATUS-CODE",

                                                        "EXPOSURE-AMOUNT",

                                                        "SURPLUS-LINES",

                                                        "PROCESSING-DATE",

                                                        "BUSINESS-TYPE",

                                                        "CLIENT-FILLER6",

                                                        "URS-TREATY-NUM",

                                                        "URS-TREATY-COMPANY",

                                                        "URS-CLAIM-NUM",

                                                        "URS-RETRO-NUM",

                                                        "FAC-CERTIFICATE",

                                                        "RISK-STATE",

                                                        "FAC-BROKER-NUM",

                                                        "INSURED-NAME",

                                                        "FISERVE-FILLER3",

                                                        "FILE-SOURCE-INDICATOR",

                                                        "AIG-BRANCH-CODE",

                                                        "AIG-COUNTRY-CODE",

                                                        "CLIENT-FILLER7",

                                                        "FISERV-FILLER4",

                                                        "CLIENT-FILLER8",

                                                        "REPORTED-DATE",

                                                        "CAUSE-OF-LOSS",

                                                        "CATASTROPHE-NUMBER",

                                                        "CLAIMANT-NAME",

                                                        "INJURY-CODE",

                                                        "ACCIDENT-STATE",

                                                        "AIG-TYPE-OF-LOSS",

                                                        "CLIENT-FILLER9",

                                                        "ACCOUNT-DATE",

                                                        "REINSURANCE-TYPE",

                                                        "CONTRACT-PLACEMENT-PERCENT",

                                                        "CONTRACT-EXPERIENCE-DATE",

                                                        "PAYMENT-MODE",

                                                        "OCCURRENCE-ID",

                                                        "CYCLE-ID",

                                                        "FISERV-FILLER5",

                                                        "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE5",

                                                        "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE6",

                                                        "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE7",

                                                        "CURRENT-CYCLE-PAID-LAE8",

                                                        "CURRENT-CYCLE-SALVAGE-LOSS",

                                                        "CURRENT-CYCLE-SALVAGE-LAE",

                                                        "CURRENT-CYCLE-SUBRO-LOSS",

                                                        "CURRENT-CYCLE-SUBRO-LAE",

                                                        "ITD-PAID-LOSS",

                                                        "ITD-PAID-LAE1",

                                                        "ITD-PAID-LAE2",

                                                        "ITD-PAID-LAE3",

                                                        "ITD-PAID-LAE4",

                                                        "ITD-PAID-LAE5",

                                                        "ITD-PAID-LAE6",

                                                        "ITD-PAID-LAE7",

                                                        "ITD-PAID-LAE8",

                                                        "ITD-SALVAGE-LAE",

                                                        "ITD-SUBRO-LAE",

                                                        "OS-LAE-2",

                                                        "INCURRED-LOSS",

                                                        "INCURRED-LAE",

                                                        "RESERVE-CREDIT",

                                                        "FISERV-FUTURE-AMOUNT-1",

                                                        "FISERV-FUTURE-AMOUNT-2"

                                                )

                                            WHERE

                                                ( "OS-LOSS" <> '+0000000000000.00'

                                                  OR "OS-LAE-1" <> '+0000000000000.00' )

                                        )

                                    GROUP BY

                                        "AIG-PRODUCT"

                                )

                            GROUP BY

                                "AIG-PRODUCT"

                        )

                );

 

        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- End P5'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_claims_control_load;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_policy_data_load (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

    BEGIN

        v_ym := in_ym;

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.MAIN';

        v_log_params := '(in_YM==>'

                        || v_ym

                        || ');';

        v_rows_processed := 0;

        pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '04- Call to prc_premium_feed_load '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_premium_feed_load(in_ym => v_ym);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '05- Call to prc_claims_feed_load '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_claims_feed_load(in_ym => v_ym);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '06- Call to prc_premium_control_load '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_premium_control_load(in_ym => v_ym);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '07- Call to prc_claims_control_load '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_claims_control_load(in_ym => v_ym);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '08- Call to prc_cip_premium_feed_load '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_cip_premium_feed_load(in_ym => v_ym);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '09- Call to prc_cip_premium_control_load '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_cip_premium_control_load(in_ym => v_ym);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '10- Call to prc_cip_claims_feed_load '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_dc_premium_control_load(in_ym => v_ym);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '10.1- Call to prc_dc_claims_feed_load '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_cip_claims_feed_load(in_ym => v_ym);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '11- Call to prc_cip_claims_control_load '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_cip_claims_control_load(in_ym => v_ym);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_log_params,

            0,

            v_date,

            '12- Call to prc_dc_claims_control_load '

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        prc_dc_claims_control_load(in_ym => v_ym);

        pk_error_log.pr_log_end_event(v_error_log_sk, v_rows_processed);

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);
