    PROCEDURE prc_client_entry_load (

        p_beginmonth NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                                   'YYYYMM') ),

        p_endmonth   NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 4),

                                                 'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.CLIENT_ENTRY';

        v_rows_processed := 0;

        v_log_params := '(p_from_month==>'

                        || p_beginmonth

                        || ',p_to_month==>'

                        || p_endmonth

                        || ');';

        pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stg_client_entry;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stg_client_entry (

            account_no,

            actual_dt,

            actual_dt_old,

            last_row_in,

            client_entry,

            new_account_date,

            new_account_yr_mon,

            account_state,

            act_opt_bucket,

            account_prm_range,

            max_cova_clt,

            max_covc_clt,

            max_covaclt_range,

            max_covcclt_range

        )

            SELECT

                *

            FROM

                (

                    WITH new_account AS (

                        SELECT DISTINCT

                            ( account_no )                account_no,

                            MAX("New Account")

                            OVER(PARTITION BY account_no) new_account_date,

                            to_char(MAX("New Account")

                                    OVER(PARTITION BY account_no),

                                    'YYYYMM')             new_account_yr_mon

                        FROM

                            (

                                SELECT DISTINCT

                                    ( t3.account_no ) account_no,

                                    t4.policy_no,

                                    t4.inception_dt,

                                    t1.inforce_ct,

                          --  SUM(t1.INFORCE_PRM_AM) AS INFORCE_PRM_AM,

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN t4.inception_dt = MIN(t4.inception_dt)

                                                               OVER(PARTITION BY t3.account_no) THEN

                                            inception_dt

                                        ELSE

                                            NULL

                                    END               "New Account"

                                FROM

                                    tpolicy_summary t1,

                                    tdate           t2,

                                    tcustomer       t3,

                                    tpolicy         t4,

                                    taccount        t5

                                WHERE

                                        t1.month_sk = t2.date_sk

--                          AND t2.date_sk = c1_rec.date_sk

                                    AND t1.customer_sk = t3.customer_sk

                                    AND t1.policy_sk = t4.policy_sk

                                    AND t5.account_sk = t3.account_sk

                                    AND t1.inforce_ct = 1

                                    AND t1.snapshot_type_in = 0

                                    AND t5.last_row_in = 'Y'

                                    AND t1.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 0, 3, 15, 2, 4,

                                                                     17 ) /*added by EAntonio on 4/3/2020 to exclude Canada*/

                                ORDER BY

                                    t3.account_no,

                                    t4.inception_dt

                            )

                    ), homebase AS (

                        SELECT

                            t17.account_no,

                            t1.item_sk,

                            t4.policy_no,

                            t6.dwelling_covrg_am cov_a,

                            t6.content_covrg_am  cov_c,

                            t7.locatn_state_cd,

                            act.act_opt_bucket,

                            act.account_prm_range,

                            t2.actual_dt,

                    --t2.date_sk,

                            CASE

                                WHEN MAX(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN t1.inforce_ct = 1

                                             AND t6.primary_residence_in = 'Y' THEN

                                            t6.dwelling_covrg_am

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                     ) = 0 THEN

                                    MAX(t6.dwelling_covrg_am)

                                    OVER(PARTITION BY t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                         ORDER BY

                                             t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                    )

                                ELSE

                                    MAX(

                                        CASE

                                            WHEN t1.inforce_ct = 1

                                                 AND t6.primary_residence_in = 'Y' THEN

                                                t6.dwelling_covrg_am

                                            ELSE

                                                0

                                        END

                                    )

                                    OVER(PARTITION BY t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                         ORDER BY

                                             t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                    )

                            END                  max_cova_clt,

                            CASE

                                WHEN MAX(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN t1.inforce_ct = 1

                                             AND t6.primary_residence_in = 'Y' THEN

                                            t6.content_covrg_am

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                     ) = 0 THEN

                                    MAX(t6.content_covrg_am)

                                    OVER(PARTITION BY t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                         ORDER BY

                                             t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                    )

                                ELSE

                                    MAX(

                                        CASE

                                            WHEN t1.inforce_ct = 1

                                                 AND t6.primary_residence_in = 'Y' THEN

                                                t6.content_covrg_am

                                            ELSE

                                                0

                                        END

                                    )

                                    OVER(PARTITION BY t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                         ORDER BY

                                             t17.account_no, t1.month_sk

                                    )

                            END                  max_covc_clt

                        FROM

                            titem_summary           t1

                            LEFT JOIN tdate                   t2 ON ( t1.month_sk = t2.date_sk )

                            LEFT JOIN tpolicy                 t4 ON ( t1.policy_sk = t4.policy_sk )

                            LEFT JOIN tcoverage               t6 ON t1.coverage_sk = t6.coverage_sk

                            LEFT JOIN tlocation               t7 ON t1.item_sk = t7.location_sk

                            LEFT JOIN tpolicy_type            t8 ON t1.policy_type_sk = t8.policy_type_sk

                            LEFT JOIN tbroker_dimension       t9 ON t4.broker_id = t9.broker_id

                                                              AND t9.last_row_in = 'Y'

                                                              AND t9.source_system_nm != 'Premier'

                            LEFT JOIN tbroker_group           t10 ON t9.broker_grp_sk = t10.broker_grp_sk

        --                    LEFT JOIN TLOCATION_SCR_RSLT_SUMMARY t11

        --                        ON     t1.MONTH_SK = t11.month_SK

        --                           AND t1.item_SK = t11.LOCATION_SK

        --                           AND t1.POLICY_SK = t11.POLICY_SK

                            LEFT JOIN torganization           t12 ON t9.organization_sk = t12.organization_sk

        --                    LEFT JOIN pcg_regions t13

        --                        ON t4.risk_state_cd = t13.state_cd

                            LEFT JOIN tsource_system          t14 ON t4.source_system_nm = t14.source_system_nm

                            LEFT JOIN tcounty_zip             t15 ON t4.insured_zip_cd = t15.zip_cd

                            LEFT JOIN tcustomer               t16 ON t4.customer_id = t16.customer_id

                                                       AND t16.last_row_in = 'Y'

                            INNER JOIN STAGE_MISREG.m_tmbr2_account   act ON ( t16.customer_id = act.customer_id )

                                                                    AND ( t2.date_sk = act.month_sk )

                            LEFT JOIN taccount                t17 ON t16.account_no = t17.account_no

                                                      AND t17.last_row_in = 'Y'

                            LEFT JOIN tunderwriter_technician t18 ON t9.uw_technician_sk = t18.uw_technician_sk

                            LEFT JOIN tbroker_tier            t19 ON t9.broker_tier_sk = t19.broker_tier_sk

                        WHERE

                                t1.inforce_ct = 1

                            AND t1.snapshot_type_in = 0

--                    AND t2.date_sk = c1_rec.date_sk

                            AND t2.actual_dt <= trunc(sysdate, 'MM') - 1

                            AND t4.policy_type_cd IN ( 'HO', 'CHO', 'MHO' )

                    ), t1 AS (

                        SELECT

                            t1.*,

                            CASE

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 1 AND 499999 THEN

                                    '1. Less than $500K'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 500000 AND 749999 THEN

                                    '2. $500K to $750K'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 750000 AND 1000000 THEN

                                    '3. $750K to $1M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 1000001 AND 2000000 THEN

                                    '4. $1M to $2M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 2000001 AND 3000000 THEN

                                    '5. $2M to $3M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 3000001 AND 5000000 THEN

                                    '6. $3M to $5M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 5000001 AND 7500000 THEN

                                    '7. $5M to $7.5M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 7500001 AND 10000000 THEN

                                    '8. $7.5M to $10M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 10000001 AND 20000000 THEN

                                    '9. $10M to $20M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 20000001 AND 30000000 THEN

                                    '10. $20M to $30M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 30000001 AND 40000000 THEN

                                    '11. $30M to $40M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 40000001 AND 50000000 THEN

                                    '12. $40M to $50M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 50000001 AND 100000000 THEN

                                    '13. $50M to $100M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 100000001 AND 200000000 THEN

                                    '14. $100M to $200M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 0

                                     AND max_cova_clt BETWEEN 200000001 AND 300000000 THEN

                                    '15. $200M to $300M'

                                WHEN max_cova_clt > 300000000 THEN

                                    '16. $300M+'

                                ELSE

                                    '17. Condo/Tenant'

                            END  AS max_covaclt_range,

                            CASE

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 1 AND 499999 THEN

                                    '1. Less than $500K'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 500000 AND 749999 THEN

                                    '2. $500K to $750K'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 750000 AND 1000000 THEN

                                    '3. $750K to $1M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 1000001 AND 2000000 THEN

                                    '4. $1M to $2M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 2000001 AND 3000000 THEN

                                    '5. $2M to $3M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 3000001 AND 5000000 THEN

                                    '6. $3M to $5M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 5000001 AND 7500000 THEN

                                    '7. $5M to $7.5M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 7500001 AND 10000000 THEN

                                    '8. $7.5M to $10M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 10000001 AND 20000000 THEN

                                    '9. $10M to $20M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 20000001 AND 30000000 THEN

                                    '10. $20M to $30M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 30000001 AND 40000000 THEN

                                    '11. $30M to $40M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 40000001 AND 50000000 THEN

                                    '12. $40M to $50M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 50000001 AND 100000000 THEN

                                    '13. $50M to $100M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 100000001 AND 200000000 THEN

                                    '14. $100M to $200M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 0

                                     AND max_covc_clt BETWEEN 200000001 AND 300000000 THEN

                                    '15. $200M to $300M'

                                WHEN max_covc_clt > 300000000 THEN

                                    '16. $300M+'

                                ELSE

                                    '17.No Cov C'

                            END  AS max_covcclt_range,

                            1    AS home_ind,

                            NULL AS non_home_state

                        FROM

                            homebase t1

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT

                            t17.account_no,

                            NULL AS item_sk,

                            t4.policy_no,

                            0    cov_a,

                            0    cov_c,

                            t4.risk_state_cd,

                            act.act_opt_bucket,

                            act.account_prm_range,

                            t2.actual_dt,

                    --t2.DATE_SK,

                            NULL AS max_cova_clt,

                            NULL AS max_covc_clt,

                            NULL AS max_covaclt_range,

                            NULL AS max_covcclt_range,

                            0    AS home_ind,

                            CASE

                                WHEN inforce_prm_am = MAX(inforce_prm_am)

                                                      OVER(PARTITION BY t17.account_no, t2.actual_dt) THEN

                                    t4.risk_state_cd

                                ELSE

                                    NULL

                            END  non_home_state

                        FROM

                            tpolicy_summary         t1

                            LEFT JOIN tdate                   t2 ON ( t1.month_sk = t2.date_sk )

                            LEFT JOIN tpolicy                 t4 ON ( t1.policy_sk = t4.policy_sk )

                            LEFT JOIN tpolicy_type            t8 ON t1.policy_type_sk = t8.policy_type_sk

                            LEFT JOIN tbroker_dimension       t9 ON t4.broker_id = t9.broker_id

                                                              AND t9.last_row_in = 'Y'

                                                              AND t9.source_system_nm != 'Premier'

                            LEFT JOIN tbroker_group           t10 ON t9.broker_grp_sk = t10.broker_grp_sk

                            LEFT JOIN torganization           t12 ON t9.organization_sk = t12.organization_sk

        --                    LEFT JOIN pcg_regions t13

        --                        ON t4.risk_state_cd = t13.state_cd

                            LEFT JOIN tsource_system          t14 ON t4.source_system_nm = t14.source_system_nm

                            LEFT JOIN tcounty_zip             t15 ON t4.insured_zip_cd = t15.zip_cd

                            LEFT JOIN tcustomer               t16 ON t4.customer_id = t16.customer_id

                                                       AND t16.last_row_in = 'Y'

                            INNER JOIN STAGE_MISREG.m_tmbr2_account   act ON ( t16.customer_id = act.customer_id )

                                                                    AND ( t2.date_sk = act.month_sk )

                            LEFT JOIN taccount                t17 ON t16.account_no = t17.account_no

                                                      AND t17.last_row_in = 'Y'

                            LEFT JOIN tunderwriter_technician t18 ON t9.uw_technician_sk = t18.uw_technician_sk

                            LEFT JOIN tbroker_tier            t19 ON t9.broker_tier_sk = t19.broker_tier_sk

                        WHERE

                                t1.inforce_ct = 1

                            AND t1.snapshot_type_in = 0

--                    AND t2.date_sk = c1_rec.date_sk

                            AND t2.actual_dt <= trunc(sysdate, 'MM') - 1

                            AND t4.policy_type_cd NOT IN ( 'HO', 'CHO', 'MHO' )

                    ), tfinal AS (

                        SELECT

                            t1.*,

                            CASE

                                WHEN t1.max_covaclt_range IS NOT NULL THEN

                                    (

                                        CASE

                                            WHEN t1.max_covaclt_range != '16. Condo/Tenant'

                                                 AND t1.max_cova_clt > 749999 THEN

                                                (

                                                    CASE

                                                        WHEN t1.cov_a = t1.max_cova_clt THEN

                                                            t1.locatn_state_cd

                                                        ELSE

                                                            NULL

                                                    END

                                                )

                                            WHEN ( t1.max_cova_clt < 750000

                                                   OR t1.max_cova_clt IS NULL )

                                                 AND t1.max_covc_clt > 499999 THEN

                                                (

                                                    CASE

                                                        WHEN t1.cov_c = t1.max_covc_clt THEN

                                                            t1.locatn_state_cd

                                                        ELSE

                                                            NULL

                                                    END

                                                )

                                            ELSE

                                                (

                                                    CASE

                                                        WHEN t1.cov_a = t1.max_cova_clt THEN

                                                            locatn_state_cd

                                                        ELSE

                                                            NULL

                                                    END

                                                )

                                        END

                                    )

                                ELSE

                                    non_home_state

                            END                                      account_state,

                            MAX(

                                CASE

                                    WHEN t1.max_covaclt_range IS NOT NULL THEN

                                        (

                                            CASE

                                                WHEN t1.max_covaclt_range != '16. Condo/Tenant'

                                                     AND t1.max_cova_clt > 749999 THEN

                                                    (

                                                        CASE

                                                            WHEN t1.cov_a = t1.max_cova_clt THEN

                                                                t1.locatn_state_cd

                                                            ELSE

                                                                NULL

                                                        END

                                                    )

                                                WHEN(t1.max_cova_clt < 750000

                                                     OR t1.max_cova_clt IS NULL)

                                                    AND t1.max_covc_clt > 499999 THEN

                                                    (

                                                        CASE

                                                            WHEN t1.cov_c = t1.max_covc_clt THEN

                                                                t1.locatn_state_cd

                                                            ELSE

                                                                NULL

                                                        END

                                                    )

                                                ELSE

                                                    (

                                                        CASE

                                                            WHEN t1.cov_a = t1.max_cova_clt THEN

                                                                locatn_state_cd

                                                            ELSE

                                                                NULL

                                                        END

                                                    )

                                            END

                                        )

                                    ELSE

                                        non_home_state

                                END

                            )

                            OVER(PARTITION BY account_no, actual_dt) account_state2,

                            SUM(home_ind)

                            OVER(PARTITION BY account_no, actual_dt) home_ct

                        FROM

                            t1

                    ), client_target AS (

                        SELECT

                            t1.*,

                            CASE

                                WHEN home_ct > 0

                                     AND account_state2 IN ( 'CA', 'FL' ) THEN

                                    'CA/FL Primary'

                                WHEN home_ct = 0

                                     AND account_state2 IN ( 'CA', 'FL' ) THEN

                                    'CA/FL Primary'

                                ELSE

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN (   ---HOME

                                                CASE

                                                    WHEN act_opt_bucket IS NULL THEN

                                                        'N'

                                                    WHEN substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) = 'N' THEN

                                                        'N'

                                                    WHEN account_state2 IN ( 'NY' )

                                                         AND ( max_cova_clt >= 1000000 )

                                                         AND substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) > '1'

                                  --and (ACT_OPT_BUCKET not in ('Monoline','2 Lines') or account_prm_range not in ('Less than $7,500'))

                                                         AND ( substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) > '2'

                                                               OR account_prm_range NOT IN ( '=< 2,500', '2,501 - $5,000', '5,001 - $7,500'

                                                               , '7,501 - $9,999' ) ) THEN

                                                        'Y'

                                                    WHEN act_opt_bucket IS NULL THEN

                                                        'N'

                                                    WHEN substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) = 'N' THEN

                                                        'N'

                                                    WHEN account_state2 NOT IN ( 'MA', 'NJ', 'TX', 'NY', 'NC' )

                                                         AND ( max_cova_clt >= 750000 )

                                                         AND substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) > '1'

                                  --and (ACT_OPT_BUCKET not in ('Monoline','2 Lines') or account_prm_range not in ('Less than $7,500'))

                                                         AND ( substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) > '2'

                                                               OR account_prm_range NOT IN ( '=< 2,500', '2,501 - $5,000', '5,001 - $7,500'

                                                               ) ) THEN

                                                        'Y'

                                                    WHEN account_state2 IN ( 'MA', 'NJ', 'TX', 'NC' )

                                                         AND ( max_cova_clt >= 750000 )

                                                         AND substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) > '1'

                                  --and (ACT_OPT_BUCKET not in ('Monoline','2 Lines') or account_prm_range not in ('Less than $7,500','$7,500-$9,999'))

                                                         AND ( substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) > '2'

                                                               OR account_prm_range NOT IN ( '=< 2,500', '2,501 - $5,000', '5,001 - $7,500'

                                                               , '7,501 - $9,999' ) ) THEN

                                                        'Y'

                                                    ELSE

                                                        'N'                     --end

                                                END

                                                || --Condo

                                                CASE

                                                    WHEN max_covaclt_range IS NOT NULL THEN

                                                            CASE

                                                                WHEN act_opt_bucket IS NULL THEN

                                                                    'N'

                                                                WHEN substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) = 'N' THEN

                                                                    'N'

                                                                WHEN account_state2 NOT IN ( 'MA', 'NJ', 'TX', 'NY', 'NC' )

                                                                     AND ( max_covc_clt >= 500000 )

                                                                     AND substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) > '1'

                                                                     AND ( substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) > 2

                                                                           OR account_prm_range NOT IN ( '=< 2,500', '2,501 - $5,000'

                                                                           , '5,001 - $7,500' ) ) THEN

                                                                    'Y'

                                                                WHEN account_state2 IN ( 'MA', 'NJ', 'TX', 'NY', 'NC' )

                                                                     AND ( max_covc_clt >= 500000 )

                                                                     AND substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) > '1'

                                                                     AND ( substr(act_opt_bucket, 1, 1) > '2'

                                                                           OR account_prm_range NOT IN ( '=< 2,500', '2,501 - $5,000'

                                                                           , '5,001 - $7,500', '7,501 - $9,999' ) ) THEN

                                                                    'Y'

                                                                ELSE

                                                                    'N'

                                                            END

                                                    ELSE

                                                        'N'

                                                END

                                            ) LIKE '%Y%' THEN

                                                'Y'

                                        ELSE

                                            'N'

                                    END

                            END client_entry

                        FROM

                            tfinal t1

                    )

                    SELECT DISTINCT

                        ( tbase.account_no )                           account_no,

                        CASE

                            WHEN t1.actual_dt IS NULL THEN

                                TO_DATE('31-DEC-99')

                            ELSE

                                t1.actual_dt

                        END                                            actual_dt,

                        t1.actual_dt                                   actual_dt_old,

                        CASE

                            WHEN (

                                CASE

                                    WHEN t1.actual_dt IS NULL THEN

                                        TO_DATE('31-DEC-99')

                                    ELSE

                                        t1.actual_dt

                                END

                            ) = MAX(

                                CASE

                                    WHEN t1.actual_dt IS NULL THEN

                                        TO_DATE('31-DEC-99')

                                    ELSE

                                        t1.actual_dt

                                END

                            )

                                OVER(PARTITION BY tbase.account_no) THEN

                                'Y'

                            ELSE

                                'N'

                        END                                            last_row_in,

                        MAX(client_entry)

                        OVER(PARTITION BY tbase.account_no, actual_dt) client_entry,

                        t2.new_account_date,

                        t2.new_account_yr_mon,

                        account_state2                                 account_state,

                        act_opt_bucket,

                        account_prm_range,

                        MAX(max_cova_clt)

                        OVER(PARTITION BY tbase.account_no, actual_dt) max_cova_clt,

                        MAX(max_covc_clt)

                        OVER(PARTITION BY tbase.account_no, actual_dt) max_covc_clt,

                        MAX(max_covaclt_range)

                        OVER(PARTITION BY tbase.account_no, actual_dt) max_covaclt_range,

                        MAX(max_covcclt_range)

                        OVER(PARTITION BY tbase.account_no, actual_dt) max_covcclt_range

                    FROM

                        taccount      tbase

                        LEFT JOIN client_target t1 ON tbase.account_no = t1.account_no

                        LEFT JOIN new_account   t2 ON tbase.account_no = t2.account_no

                    WHERE

                        tbase.last_row_in = 'Y'

                    ORDER BY

                        tbase.account_no

                );

 

        v_rows_processed := SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        pk_error_log.pr_log_end_event(v_error_log_sk, v_rows_processed);

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_client_entry_load;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_m_tmbr2_account IS

    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.m_tmbr2_account;

 

        COMMIT;

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.MBR2';

        v_rows_processed := 0;

        v_log_params := '(PRC_M_TMBR2_ACCOUNT=> Full Reload);';

        pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.m_tmbr2_account (

            account_no,

            customer_id,

            actual_dt,

            year_ct,

            month_ct,

            month_sk,

            inforce_ct,

            customer_prm,

            au,

            ho,

            pe,

            pc,

            yht,

            ot,

            platinum_account_in,

            account_since_dt,

            special_handling,

            account_prm,

            act_opt_bucket,

            act_opt_bucket_orig,

            account_prm_range,

            years_pcg,

            max_year_end,

            start_dt,

            end_dt,

            us_home_in,

            us_home_in2

        )

            SELECT

                *

            FROM

                (

                    WITH accountprm1 AS (

                        SELECT

                            t3.account_no,

                            t3.customer_id,

                            t2.actual_dt,

                            t2.year_ct,

                            t2.month_ct,

                            t1.month_sk,

                            t1.inforce_ct,

                            SUM(t1.inforce_prm_am) AS customer_prm,

                            SUM(

                                CASE

                                    WHEN t4.policy_type_cd IN('AU', 'MAU', 'CAU') THEN

                                        t1.inforce_prm_am

                                    ELSE

                                        0

                                END

                            )                      au,

                            SUM(

                                CASE

                                    WHEN t4.policy_type_cd IN('HO', 'MHO', 'CHO') THEN

                                        t1.inforce_prm_am

                                    ELSE

                                        0

                                END

                            )                      ho,

                            SUM(

                                CASE

                                    WHEN t4.policy_type_cd IN('PE', 'CPE') THEN

                                        t1.inforce_prm_am

                                    ELSE

                                        0

                                END

                            )                      pe,

                            SUM(

                                CASE

                                    WHEN t4.policy_type_cd IN('PC', 'CPI') THEN

                                        t1.inforce_prm_am

                                    ELSE

                                        0

                                END

                            )                      pc,

                            SUM(

                                CASE

                                    WHEN t4.policy_type_cd IN('YHT') THEN

                                        t1.inforce_prm_am

                                    ELSE

                                        0

                                END

                            )                      yht,

                            SUM(

                                CASE

                                    WHEN t4.policy_type_cd NOT IN('AU', 'MAU', 'CAU', 'HO', 'MHO',

                                                                  'CHO', 'PE', 'CPE', 'PC', 'CPI',

                                                                  'YHT') THEN

                                        t1.inforce_prm_am

                                    ELSE

                                        0

                                END

                            )                      ot,

                            t5.platinum_account_in,

                            t5.account_since_dt,

                            t5.special_handling

                        FROM

                            tpolicy_summary t1,

                            tdate           t2,

                            tcustomer       t3,

                            tpolicy         t4,

                            taccount        t5

                        WHERE

                                t1.month_sk = t2.date_sk

                            AND t1.customer_sk = t3.customer_sk

                            AND t1.policy_sk = t4.policy_sk

                            AND t5.account_sk = t3.account_sk

                            AND t1.inforce_ct = 1

                            AND t1.snapshot_type_in = 0

                            AND t5.last_row_in = 'Y'

                            AND t2.actual_dt BETWEEN '1-JAN-2000' AND trunc(sysdate, 'MM') - 1

                            AND t1.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 0, 3, 15, 2, 4,

                                                             17 ) /*added by EAntonio on 4/3/2020 to exclude Canada*/

        --   and t3.ACCOUNT_NO               = '10000072'

                        GROUP BY

                            t3.account_no,

                            t3.account_no,

                            t2.actual_dt,

                            t2.year_ct,

                            t2.month_ct,

                            t1.month_sk,

                            t5.platinum_account_in,

                            t5.account_since_dt,

                            t5.special_handling,

                            t3.customer_id,

                            t1.inforce_ct

                    ), max_account_dt AS (

                        SELECT

                            a.account_no,

                            a.year_ct,

                            MAX(a.actual_dt) max_calendaryear_dt

                        FROM

                            accountprm1 a

                        GROUP BY

                            a.account_no,

                            a.year_ct

                    ), final_account AS (

                        SELECT

                            t2.*,

                            CASE

                                WHEN inforce_ct = 1 THEN

                                    SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                    OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ORDER BY

                                             t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                    )

                                ELSE

                                    0

                            END                                                             account_prm,

          --NEW uses old variable name

                            CASE

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.yht)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0 THEN

                                    '5-HO/AU/PC/PE/YHT'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.yht)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) <= 0 THEN

                                    '4-HO/AU/PC/PE'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                            END                                                             act_opt_bucket,

 

          --ORIGINAL

                                         ) > 0

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0 THEN

                                    '4-HO/AU/PC/PE'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0 THEN

                                    '3-HO/AU/PE'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0 THEN

                                    '3-HO/PC/PE'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0 THEN

                                    '2-HO/AU'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0 THEN

                                    '2-HO/PC'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0 THEN

                                    '2-HO/PE'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0 THEN

                                    '1-HO'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0 THEN

                                    '1-AU'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0 THEN

                                    '1-PC'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.ho)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.au)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pc)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) = 0

                                     AND SUM(t2.pe)

                                         OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                              ORDER BY

                                                  t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                         ) > 0 THEN

                                    '1-PE'
