                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) = 0 THEN

                                    '0-HO'

                                ELSE

                                    'N/A'

                            END                                                             act_opt_bucket_orig,

                            CASE

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) IS NULL THEN

                                    'N/A'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) = 0                         THEN

                                    'N/A'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) < 2501                      THEN

                                    '=< 2,500'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) BETWEEN 2500.99 AND 5000    THEN

                                    '2,501 - $5,000'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) BETWEEN 5000.99 AND 7500    THEN

                                    '5,001 - $7,500'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) BETWEEN 7500.99 AND 9999.99 THEN

                                    '7,501 - $9,999'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) BETWEEN 10000 AND 24999.99  THEN

                                    '$10,000 - $24,999'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) BETWEEN 25000 AND 49999.99  THEN

                                    '$25,000 - $49,999' -- Added as requested by Rich/Jake/Hany

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999.99  THEN

                                    '$50,000 - $99,999' -- Added as requested by Rich/Jake/Hany

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) BETWEEN 100000 AND 249999   THEN

                                    '$100,000 - $249,999'

                                WHEN SUM(t2.customer_prm)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                          ORDER BY

                                              t2.actual_dt, t2.account_no

                                     ) >= 250000                   THEN

                                    '$250,000+'

                                ELSE

                                    'N/A'

                            END                                                             AS account_prm_range,

                            to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY') - to_char(t2.account_since_dt, 'YYYY') AS years_pcg,

                            CASE

                                WHEN t3.max_calendaryear_dt IS NOT NULL THEN

                                    'Y'

                                ELSE

                                    'N'

                            END                                                             AS max_year_end,

                            ROW_NUMBER()

                            OVER(PARTITION BY t2.customer_id

                                 ORDER BY

                                     actual_dt

                            )                                                               rn

                        FROM

                            accountprm1    t2

                            LEFT JOIN max_account_dt t3 ON ( t2.account_no = t3.account_no )

                                                           AND ( t2.year_ct = t3.year_ct )

                                                           AND ( t2.actual_dt = t3.max_calendaryear_dt )

                    ), inforce_ho AS (

                        SELECT DISTINCT

                            c.actual_dt,

                            e.customer_id

                        FROM

                                 titem_summary a

                            INNER JOIN tlocation           b ON ( a.item_sk = b.location_sk )

                            INNER JOIN tdate               c ON ( a.month_sk = c.date_sk )

                            INNER JOIN trisk_state_country d ON ( b.location_state_country_sk = d.risk_state_country_sk )

                            INNER JOIN tpolicy             e ON ( a.policy_sk = e.policy_sk )

                        WHERE

                                a.snapshot_type_in = 0

                            AND a.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 0, 3, 15, 2, 4,

                                                            17 )

                            AND d.risk_country_nm = 'UNITED STATES'

                            AND e.policy_type_cd IN ( 'HO' ) /*removed MHO E.Antonio 5/14/2020*/

                            AND a.inforce_ct = 1

          --AND e.customer_id='0002000133'

                    )

                    SELECT

                        a.account_no,

                        a.customer_id,

                        a.actual_dt,

                        a.year_ct,

                        a.month_ct,

                        a.month_sk,

                        a.inforce_ct,

                        a.customer_prm,

                        a.au,

                        a.ho,

                        a.pe,

                        a.pc,

                        a.yht,

                        a.ot,

                        a.platinum_account_in,

                        a.account_since_dt,

                        a.special_handling,

                        a.account_prm,

                        a.act_opt_bucket,

                        a.act_opt_bucket_orig,

                        a.account_prm_range,

                        a.years_pcg,

                        a.max_year_end,

                        CASE

                            WHEN rn = 1 THEN

                                TO_DATE('01-jan-1970')

                            ELSE

                                a.actual_dt

                        END AS start_dt,

                        CASE

                            WHEN rn = 1

                                 AND MAX(rn)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY a.customer_id) > 1 THEN

                                LEAD(a.actual_dt)

                                OVER(PARTITION BY a.customer_id

                                     ORDER BY

                                         a.actual_dt

                                ) - 1

                            WHEN rn = 1

                                 AND MAX(rn)

                                     OVER(PARTITION BY a.customer_id) = 1 THEN

                                TO_DATE('31-dec-2099')

                            WHEN rn = MAX(rn)

                                      OVER(PARTITION BY a.customer_id) THEN

                                TO_DATE('31-dec-2099')

                            ELSE

                                LEAD(a.actual_dt)

                                OVER(PARTITION BY a.customer_id

                                     ORDER BY

                                         a.actual_dt

                                ) - 1

                        END AS end_dt,

 

        --INDICATOR AT THE ACCOUNT LEVEL

                        CASE

                            WHEN SUM(

                                CASE

                                    WHEN b.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN

                                        1

                                    ELSE

                                        0

                                END

                            )

                                 OVER(PARTITION BY a.account_no, a.actual_dt) > 0 THEN

                                'Y'

                            ELSE

                                'N'

                        END AS us_home_in,

                        CASE

                            WHEN SUM(

                                CASE

                                    WHEN a.ho > 0 THEN

                                        1

                                    ELSE

                                        0

                                END

                            )

                                 OVER(PARTITION BY a.account_no, a.actual_dt) > 0 THEN

                                'Y'

                            ELSE

                                'N'

                        END AS us_home_in2

                    FROM

                        final_account a

                        LEFT JOIN inforce_ho    b ON ( a.customer_id = b.customer_id )

                                                  AND ( a.actual_dt = b.actual_dt )

                );

 

        COMMIT;

        pk_error_log.pr_log_end_event(v_error_log_sk, v_rows_processed);

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_m_tmbr2_account;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_client_entry_upd_2_history (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.CLIENT_ENTRY_UPD';

        v_rows_processed := 0;

        v_ym := in_ym;

        v_log_params := 'Client Entry Update to History Table';

        pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

    --Get Month SK, Prev Month Sk, month begin SK, END SK (01-JAN, 31-JAN for example) etc.,

        SELECT

            date_sk,

            actual_dt

        INTO

            v_month_sk,

            v_fulldate

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

                year_month_ct = v_ym

            AND month_end_in = 'Y';

 

        SELECT

            date_sk

        INTO v_prev_month_sk

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

                year_month_ct = to_char((add_months(v_fulldate, - 1)),

                                        'yyyymm')

            AND month_end_in = 'Y';

 

        SELECT

            MIN(date_sk),

            MAX(date_sk)

        INTO

            v_begin_date_sk,

            v_end_date_sk

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

            year_month_ct = v_ym;

 

         /* Selecting month begin date and enddate-1 */

        SELECT

            actual_dt

        INTO v_begin_date

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

            date_sk = v_begin_date_sk;

 

        v_end_date := v_fulldate - 1;

         /********************************************/

 

        SELECT

            date_sk,

            actual_dt

        INTO

            v_yr_begin_dt_sk,

            v_yr_begin_act_dt

        FROM

            tdate

        WHERE

            ( date_sk, year_ct ) IN (

                SELECT

                    MIN(date_sk), MAX(year_ct) year_ct

                FROM

                    tdate

                WHERE

                    substr(year_month_ct, 1, 4) = substr(v_ym, 1, 4)

            );

 

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- Delete Data'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details (

            account_no,

            policy_no,

            inception_dt,

            expiration_dt,

            policy_sk

        )

            SELECT DISTINCT

                a.account_no,

                a.policy_no,

                a.inception_dt,

                a.expiration_dt,

                CASE

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) >= 2020 THEN

                        1

                    ELSE

                        0

                END client_2020

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT

                        a.account_no,

                        b.policy_no,

                        b.inception_dt,

                        b.expiration_dt,

                        a.customer_id

                    FROM

                        tcustomer a,

                        tpolicy   b

                    WHERE

                            a.customer_id = b.customer_id

                        AND b.inception_dt >= '01-JAN-2020'

                        AND b.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 0, 3, 15, 2, 4,

                                                        17 )

                ) a

    /*First pass*/

                LEFT JOIN (

                    SELECT DISTINCT

                        account_no,

                        last_row_in,

                        client_entry

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.stg_client_entry

                    WHERE

                        client_entry = 'Y'

                ) t22 ON a.account_no = t22.account_no

    /*Second pass*/

                LEFT JOIN (

                    SELECT DISTINCT

                        account_no,

                        last_row_in,

                        client_entry

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.stg_client_entry

                    WHERE

                        client_entry = 'Y'

                ) t23 ON ( a.account_no = t23.account_no )

                         AND t23.last_row_in = 'Y'

            WHERE

                    coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                AND a.inception_dt >= '01-JAN-2020'

                AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN a.inception_dt AND a.expiration_dt; --Inception date condition Valid for one year from Inception date

 

        COMMIT;

        UPDATE STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

        SET

            prev_flag = flag,

            client_entry = 'Y',

            flag = 'Y'

        WHERE

            ( account_no, policy_no, inception_dt ) IN (

                SELECT

                    account_no, policy_no, inception_dt

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details

                WHERE

                    policy_sk = 1

            )

            AND flag <> 'Y';

 

        UPDATE STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details

        SET

            client_entry = 'Y'

        WHERE

            ( account_no, policy_no, inception_dt ) IN (

                SELECT

                    account_no, policy_no, inception_dt

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details

                WHERE

                    policy_sk = 1

            )

            AND flag = 'Y';

 

        UPDATE STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_premium_details

        SET

            aig_acct_gt_10k = 'Y'

        WHERE

            ( account_no, policy_no, effective_dt ) IN (

                SELECT

                    account_no, policy_no, inception_dt

                FROM

                    STAGE_MISREG.gtt_stg_account_prm_details

                WHERE

                    policy_sk = 1

            )

            AND aig_acct_gt_10k <> 'Y';

 

        v_rows_processed := SQL%rowcount;

        pk_error_log.pr_log_end_event(v_error_log_sk, v_rows_processed);

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_client_entry_upd_2_history;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_pcg_segment_flag AS

        start_time NUMBER;

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.PCG_SEGMENT';

        v_rows_processed := 0;

        v_log_params := '(No Params)';

        pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.tpcg_segment_base;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.tpcg_segment_base (

            actual_dt,

            account_no,

            customer_id,

            month_sk,

            policy_sk,

            policy_no,

            inception_dt,

            source_system_sk,

            previous_pcg_policy_no,

            reissued_pcg_policy_no,

            max_record,

            jet_2019,

            jet_2020,

            safeco_heri,

            decline_safeco_heri,

            client_2019,

            client_2020,

            ca_fl_primary,

            pcg_segment_flag,

            pcg_segment_flag_org,

            it_client_entry,

            us_home_in,

            account_group,

            account_prm_range,

            act_opt_bucket,

            platinum_account_in,

            account_since_dt,

            special_handling,

            rn

        )

            SELECT

                a.actual_dt,

                d.account_no,

                a.customer_id,

                a.month_sk,

                a.policy_sk,

                a.policy_no,

                a.inception_dt,

                a.source_system_sk,

                previous_pcg_policy_no,

                reissued_pcg_policy_no,

                     /*new item added by EAntonio to fix orphan claims*/

                CASE

                    WHEN a.actual_dt = MAX(a.actual_dt)

                                           OVER(PARTITION BY a.policy_no)

                         AND a.inception_dt = MAX(a.inception_dt)

                                              OVER(PARTITION BY a.policy_no) THEN

                        'Y'

                    ELSE

                        'N'

                END                max_record,

                CASE

                    WHEN ( d.account_group = '10K+'

                           AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) < 2020

                           AND d.us_home_in = 'Y' ) THEN

                        1

                    ELSE

                        0

                END                jet_2019,

                CASE

                    WHEN f2020.policy_sk IS NOT NULL THEN

                        1

                    WHEN f2021.policy_sk IS NOT NULL THEN

                        1

                    ELSE

                        0

                END                jet_2020,

               --      case when (g.policy_sk IS NOT NULL AND extract (YEAR FROM a.inception_dt)>=2020) THEN 1 else 0 end AUGUSTA_TO_JET_2020,

                CASE

                    WHEN ( h.policy_sk IS NOT NULL

                           AND h.final_6_23_2020 NOT LIKE '%Decline%' ) THEN

                        1

                    ELSE

                        0

                END                safeco_heri,

                CASE

                    WHEN ( h.policy_sk IS NOT NULL

                           AND h.final_6_23_2020 LIKE '%Decline%' ) THEN

                        1

                    ELSE

                        0

                END                decline_safeco_heri,

                CASE

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) < 2020 THEN

                        1

                    ELSE

                        0

                END                client_2019,

                CASE

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) >= 2020 THEN

                        1

                    ELSE

                        0

                END                client_2020,

                CASE

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'CA/FL Primary'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) >= 2020 THEN

                        1

                    ELSE

                        0

                END                "CA/FL Primary",

                CASE

                              /*Priority in order given to Augusta contract, hence first in case statement and also addressed cancel-rewrites*/

                    WHEN ( h.policy_no IS NOT NULL

                           AND h.final_6_23_2020 NOT LIKE '%Decline%' ) THEN

                        'SAFECO-HERITAGE'

                    WHEN ( h.policy_no IS NOT NULL

                           AND h.final_6_23_2020 LIKE '%Decline%' ) THEN

                        'DECLINE-SAFECO-HERITAGE'

                      /* Part 1 new item cancel re-write added by Enmanuel 9/10/2020*/

                    WHEN ( h2.policy_no IS NOT NULL

                           AND h2.final_6_23_2020 NOT LIKE '%Decline%' ) THEN

                        'SAFECO-HERITAGE'

                    WHEN ( h2.policy_no IS NOT NULL

                           AND h2.final_6_23_2020 LIKE '%Decline%' ) THEN

                        'DECLINE-SAFECO-HERITAGE'

                              /* Part 2 new item cancel re-write added by Enmanuel 9/10/2020*/

                    WHEN ( h3.policy_no IS NOT NULL

                           AND h3.final_6_23_2020 NOT LIKE '%Decline%' ) THEN

                        'SAFECO-HERITAGE'

                    WHEN ( h3.policy_no IS NOT NULL

                           AND h3.final_6_23_2020 LIKE '%Decline%' ) THEN

                        'DECLINE-SAFECO-HERITAGE'

                    WHEN a.source_system_sk IN ( 14 ) THEN

                        'DECLINE-SAFECO-HERITAGE'

                 /*added by Enmanuel 10/15/2020*/

                 -- Rested by Fadi 5/21/2021 because no needs for this exception anymore

                 --          WHEN

                 --                 a.policy_no IN ('0006947741','0016090021') AND extract (YEAR FROM a.inception_dt)>=2020 THEN 'JET-2020'

 

                    WHEN f2020.policy_sk IS NOT NULL

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) = 2020 THEN

                        'JET-2020'

                    WHEN f2021.policy_sk IS NOT NULL

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) = 2021 THEN

                        'JET-2021'

                    WHEN f2022.policy_sk IS NOT NULL

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) = 2022 THEN

                        'JET-2022' /* Added by Fadi to create JET-2022 segment */

           -- WHEN (g.policy_sk IS NOT NULL AND extract (YEAR FROM a.inception_dt)>=2020) THEN 'AUGUSTA_TO_JET_IN'

                    WHEN ( d.account_group = '10K+'

                           AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) < 2020

                           AND d.us_home_in = 'Y' ) THEN

                        'JET-2019 ESTIMATE'

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) < 2020 THEN

                        'CLIENT 2019'

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) = 2020 THEN

                        'CLIENT 2020'

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) = 2021 THEN

                        'CLIENT 2021'

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) = 2022 THEN

                        'CLIENT 2022'  /* Added by Fadi to create CLIENT 2022 segment */

                    ELSE

                        'Other - DNR'

                END                pcg_segment_flag,

                   /*original flag prior to 9/11/2020*/

                CASE

                    WHEN f2020.policy_sk IS NOT NULL THEN

                        'JET-2020'

               --        WHEN (g.policy_sk IS NOT NULL AND extract (YEAR FROM a.inception_dt)>=2020) THEN 'AUGUSTA_TO_JET_IN'

                    WHEN ( d.account_group = '10K+'

                           AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) < 2020

                           AND d.us_home_in = 'Y' ) THEN

                        'JET-2019 ESTIMATE'

                    WHEN ( h.policy_no IS NOT NULL

                           AND h.final_6_23_2020 NOT LIKE '%Decline%' ) THEN

                        'SAFECO-HERITAGE'

                    WHEN ( h.policy_no IS NOT NULL

                           AND h.final_6_23_2020 LIKE '%Decline%' ) THEN

                        'DECLINE-SAFECO-HERITAGE'

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) < 2020 THEN

                        'CLIENT 2019'

                              --when coalesce(t22.Client_Entry,t23.Client_Entry) = 'Y' and extract (YEAR FROM a.inception_dt)>=2020 then 'CLIENT 2020'/* Rested by Fadi and changed on the next line*/

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) = 2020 THEN

                        'CLIENT 2020'   /* Added by Fadi to create CLIENT 2020 Segment on PCG_SEGMENT_FLAG_ORG */

                    WHEN coalesce(t22.client_entry, t23.client_entry) = 'Y'

                         AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.inception_dt) >= 2021 THEN

                        'CLIENT 2021' /* Added by Fadi to create CLIENT 2021 Segment on PCG_SEGMENT_FLAG_ORG */

                    ELSE

                        'Other - DNR'

                END                pcg_segment_flag_org,

                f2020.client_entry it_client_entry,

                d.us_home_in,

                d.account_group,

                d.account_prm_range,

                d.act_opt_bucket,

                d.platinum_account_in,

                d.account_since_dt,

                d.special_handling,

                ROW_NUMBER()

                OVER(PARTITION BY a.policy_sk

                     ORDER BY

                         a.actual_dt

                )                  rn

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT DISTINCT

                        b.actual_dt,

                        c.policy_no,

                        c.inception_dt,

                        c.customer_id,

                        a.month_sk,

                        a.policy_sk,

                        a.source_system_sk,/*new item cancel re-write added by Enmanuel 9/10/2020*/

                        previous_pcg_policy_no,

                        reissued_pcg_policy_no

                    FROM

                        tpolicy_summary a

                        LEFT JOIN tdate           b ON a.month_sk = b.date_sk

                        LEFT JOIN tpolicy         c ON a.policy_sk = c.policy_sk

                    WHERE

                        a.source_system_sk NOT IN ( 0, 3, 15, 2, 4,

                                                    17 )

                        AND a.snapshot_type_in = 0  /*AND c. policy_no IN ('0099701955','0042711494','0042711979','0065406963','0099701255','0015384239')*/

               --        and a.inforce_ct = 1

                        AND b.actual_dt <= trunc(sysdate, 'MM') - 1

                    ORDER BY

                        a.policy_sk,

                        b.actual_dt

                )                      a

                LEFT JOIN (

                    SELECT

                        customer_id,

                        start_dt,

                        end_dt,

                        month_sk,

                        us_home_in,

                        account_no,

                        account_prm_range,

                        act_opt_bucket,

                        platinum_account_in,

                        account_since_dt,

                        special_handling,

                        CASE

                            WHEN account_prm BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN

                                'Up to 10K'

                            WHEN account_prm > 10000             THEN

                                '10K+'

                            ELSE

                                'ERROR'

                        END AS account_group

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.m_tmbr2_account

                )                      d ON a.customer_id = d.customer_id

                       AND a.actual_dt BETWEEN d.start_dt AND d.end_dt

                LEFT JOIN (

                    SELECT

                        b.actual_dt,

                        a.*

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details a

                        LEFT JOIN tdate                                b ON ( a.month_sk = b.date_sk )

                    WHERE

                            flag = 'Y'

                        AND actual_dt = '31-DEC-2020'

                )                      f2020 ON a.policy_sk = f2020.policy_sk

                LEFT JOIN (

                    SELECT

                        b.actual_dt,

                        a.*

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details a

                        LEFT JOIN tdate                                b ON ( a.month_sk = b.date_sk )

                    WHERE

                            flag = 'Y'

                                --AND actual_dt= trunc(sysdate,'MM')-1   /* Rested By Fadi on 01/17/2022 */

                        AND actual_dt = '31-DEC-2021'  --Fadi Added by Fadi on 01/17/2022

                )                      f2021 ON a.policy_sk = f2021.policy_sk

 

          /* added by Fadi on 01/17/2022 to add Jet 2022*/

                LEFT JOIN (

                    SELECT

                        b.actual_dt,

                        a.*

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details a

                        LEFT JOIN tdate                                b ON ( a.month_sk = b.date_sk )

                    WHERE

                            flag = 'Y'

                        AND actual_dt = trunc(sysdate, 'MM') - 1

                )                      f2022 ON a.policy_sk = f2022.policy_sk

 

                     /*Addresses original Augusta List*/

                LEFT JOIN (

                    SELECT

                        policy_sk,

                        lpad(policy_no, 10, '0') policy_no,

                        final_6_23_2020

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.augusta_final202006

                )                      h ON a.policy_no = h.policy_no

                              /*Addresses original Augusta list cancel rewrites 1*/

                LEFT JOIN (

                    SELECT

                        policy_sk,

                        lpad(policy_no, 10, '0') policy_no,

                        final_6_23_2020

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.augusta_final202006

                )                      h2 ON a.previous_pcg_policy_no = h2.policy_no

                     /*Addresses original Augusta list cancel rewrites 2*/

                LEFT JOIN (

                    SELECT

                        policy_sk,

                        lpad(policy_no, 10, '0') policy_no,

                        final_6_23_2020

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.augusta_final202006

                )                      h3 ON a.reissued_pcg_policy_no = h3.policy_no

                LEFT JOIN STAGE_MISREG.stg_client_entry t22 ON ( d.account_no = t22.account_no )

                                                        AND ( a.actual_dt = t22.actual_dt )

                LEFT JOIN STAGE_MISREG.stg_client_entry t23 ON ( d.account_no = t23.account_no )

                                                        AND t23.last_row_in = 'Y';

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.tpcg_segment_flag;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.tpcg_segment_flag (

            actual_dt,

            account_no,

            customer_id,

            month_sk,

            policy_sk,

            policy_no,

            inception_dt,

            source_system_sk,

            previous_pcg_policy_no,

            reissued_pcg_policy_no,

            max_record,

            jet_2019,

            jet_2020,

            safeco_heri,

            decline_safeco_heri,

            client_2019,

            client_2020,

            ca_fl_primary,

            pcg_segment_flag,

            pcg_segment_flag_org,

            it_client_entry,

            us_home_in,

            account_group,

            account_prm_range,

            act_opt_bucket,

            platinum_account_in,

            account_since_dt,

            special_handling,

            rn,

            trigger_last_update_ts,

            augusta,

            start_dt,

            end_dt

        ) --9.              Added TRIGGER_LAST_UPDATE_TS

            SELECT

                a.*,

                CASE

                    WHEN pcg_segment_flag IN ( 'SAFECO-HERITAGE', 'DECLINE-SAFECO-HERITAGE' ) THEN

                        1

                    WHEN client_2019 = 0

                         AND jet_2019 = 0 THEN

                        1

                    ELSE

                        0

                END augusta,

                CASE

                    WHEN rn = 1 THEN

                        TO_DATE('01-jan-1970')

                    ELSE

                        a.actual_dt

                END AS start_dt,

                CASE

                    WHEN rn = 1

                         AND MAX(rn)

                             OVER(PARTITION BY a.policy_sk) > 1 THEN

                        LEAD(a.actual_dt)

                        OVER(PARTITION BY policy_sk

                             ORDER BY

                                 a.actual_dt

                        ) - 1

                    WHEN rn = 1

                         AND MAX(rn)

                             OVER(PARTITION BY policy_sk) = 1 THEN

                        TO_DATE('31-dec-2099')

                    WHEN rn = MAX(rn)

                              OVER(PARTITION BY a.policy_sk) THEN

                        TO_DATE('31-dec-2099')

                    ELSE

                        LEAD(a.actual_dt)

                        OVER(PARTITION BY a.policy_sk

                             ORDER BY

                                 a.actual_dt

                        ) - 1

                END AS end_dt

            FROM

                STAGE_MISREG.tpcg_segment_base a;

 

        v_rows_processed := SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        pk_error_log.pr_log_end_event(v_error_log_sk, v_rows_processed);

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_pcg_segment_flag;

 

    FUNCTION f_zone_decimal_conv (

        p_sign VARCHAR2,

        p_val  NUMBER

    ) RETURN VARCHAR2 AS

 

        TYPE arr_pos_zone_decimal IS

            VARRAY(9) OF VARCHAR2(1);

        TYPE arr_neg_zone_decimal IS

            VARRAY(9) OF VARCHAR2(1);

        a_pos_zone_decimal arr_pos_zone_decimal := arr_pos_zone_decimal('A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E',

                                                                       'F', 'G', 'H', 'I');

        a_neg_zone_decimal arr_neg_zone_decimal := arr_neg_zone_decimal('J', 'K', 'L', 'M', 'N',

                                                                       'O', 'P', 'Q', 'R');

    BEGIN

        IF p_sign = '+' THEN

            IF p_val = 0 THEN

                RETURN '{';

            ELSIF p_val > 0 THEN

                RETURN a_pos_zone_decimal(p_val);

            END IF;

 

        ELSIF p_sign = '-' THEN

            IF p_val = 0 THEN

                RETURN '}';

            ELSIF p_val > 0 THEN

                RETURN a_neg_zone_decimal(p_val);

            END IF;

        END IF;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            RETURN 0;

    END f_zone_decimal_conv;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_cip_premium_feed_load (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

 

        v_begin_dt    DATE;

        v_end_dt      DATE;

        v_begin_dt_sk NUMBER;

        v_end_dt_sk   NUMBER;

        CURSOR c1 IS

        SELECT

            MIN(date_sk)   begin_dtsk,

            MIN(actual_dt) begin_dt,

            MAX(date_sk)   end_dtsk,

            MAX(actual_dt) end_dt

        FROM

            tdate d

        WHERE

            pcs_month_acctng_ct = in_ym

        GROUP BY

            pcs_month_acctng_ct

        ORDER BY

            3;

 

    BEGIN

        FOR c1_rec IN c1 LOOP

            v_begin_dt := c1_rec.begin_dt;

            v_end_dt := c1_rec.end_dt;

            v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.CIP_PRM';

            v_rows_processed := 0;

            v_log_params := '(in_YM==>'

                            || in_ym

                            || ');';

            pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

            INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

                v_module_name

                || ' - '

                || in_ym

                || ' - '

                || v_begin_dt

                || ' - '

                || v_end_dt,

                0,

                sysdate,

                '01- Begin P1'

            );

 

            COMMIT;

            DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_premium_feed_details

            WHERE

                param_num = in_ym;

 

            COMMIT;

            INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_premium_feed_details (

                fiserv_premium_record,

                param_num,

                load_timestamp

            )

                SELECT

                    *

                FROM

                    (

                        WITH main_qry AS (

                            SELECT

                                rpad(' ', 15, ' ')               AS "Primary-Package-ID",

                                rpad(' ', 15, ' ')               AS "Secondary-Package-ID",

                                rpad(a.policy_no, 15, ' ')       AS "POLICY-NUMBER",

                                LEFT JOIN tpim_coverage                j ON c.coverage_sk = j.pim_coverage_sk

                                LEFT JOIN tpel_coverage                k ON c.coverage_sk = k.pel_coverage_sk

                                LEFT JOIN ttransaction_type            l ON c.tran_type_sk = l.tran_type_sk

                                LEFT JOIN tuw_company                  b ON TRIM(b.uw_co_cd_1) = TRIM(a.uw_co_cd)

                                LEFT JOIN trisk_state_country          n ON a.risk_state_country_sk = n.risk_state_country_sk

                                JOIN tdate                        e ON e.date_sk = c.transaction_dt_sk

                --JOIN tdate F ON F.DATE_SK = C.ACCOUNTING_DT_SK

                                JOIN tdate                        h ON h.date_sk = c.effective_dt_sk

                                LEFT JOIN tprocessing_office           po ON TRIM(a.uw_center_nm) = TRIM(po.processing_office_desc_tx

                                )

                                LEFT JOIN STAGE_MISREG.stage_mjc_coveragecode smcc   --Added for DC Policies

                                 ON ( smcc.coverage_cd = ctd.covrg_type_cd

                                                                                 AND smcc.risk_state_cd = a.risk_state_cd

                                                                                 AND smcc.product_cd = (

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN a.source_system_sk IN ( 16, 17 ) THEN

                                            m.policy_type_cip_cd

                                        WHEN a.source_system_sk IN ( 18, 19, 20, 21 ) THEN

                                            m.policy_type_dc_cd

                                    END

                                )

                                                                                 AND smcc.source_system_nm = a.source_system_nm )   --Added for DC Policies

                                LEFT JOIN tmisc_coverage          misc ON misc.policy_no = a.policy_no

                                                                      AND misc.inception_dt = a.inception_dt

                                                                      AND misc.effective_dt = h.actual_dt

                                                                      AND misc.transaction_dt = e.actual_dt

                                                                      AND misc.expiration_dt = a.expiration_dt --12.0 Added Instanda changes in DC loss feed and MISC_COVERAGE filter condition in premium

                                                                        --AND misc.last_row_in = 'Y'   --Harikrishna Modified to Include Instanda changes in the filter condition

                            WHERE

                                TRIM(a.policy_type_cd) IN ( 'EXFL', 'HO', 'AU', 'PE', 'PC',

                                                            'EQ', 'CHO', 'CAU', 'YHT' )   --Harikrishna Modified to Include Instanda changes in the filter condition

                --AND NVL(SMCC.PRODUCT_TYPE_NM,'Admitted') = 'Admitted' --Added for DC policies

                                AND a.source_system_sk IN ( 16, 17, 18, 19, 20,

                                                            21 )  --Harikrishna Modified to Include Instanda changes in the filter condition

                        ), acc_prm AS (

                            SELECT

                                rpad(nvl(account_no, ' '),

                                     10,

                                     ' ')                "AIG-ACCOUNT#_B",

                                rpad(nvl(aig_acct_gt_10k, ' '),

                                     1,

                                     ' ')                "AIG_ACCT_GT_10K",

                                rpad(policy_no, 15, ' ') AS "POLICY-NUMBER_B",

                                rpad(to_char(effective_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                     10,

                                     ' ')                AS "POLICY-EFFECTIVE_B"

                            FROM

                                STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_premium_details aph

                        )

                        SELECT

                            "Primary-Package-ID"

                            || "Secondary-Package-ID"

                            || "POLICY-NUMBER"

                            || "COMPANY-NUM"

                            || "MODULE-NUM"

                            || "UNIT-NUM"

                            || "COVERAGE-EFFECTIVE"

                            || "POLICY-EFFECTIVE"

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER1"

                            || "RECORD-TYPE"

                            || "ENTRY-DATE"

                            || "PACKAGE-POLICY-IND"

                            || "POLICY-STATE"

                            || "FISERV-FILLER1"

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER2"

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER3"

                            || "EXPIRATION-DATE"

                            || "AGENCY-NUM"

                            || "MAJOR-PERIL"

                            || "SEQUENCE-NUM"

                            || "LINE-OF-BUSINESS"

                            || "CLAIMANT"

                            || "FISERVE-FILLER2"

                            || "AIG-PRODUCT"

                            || "AIG-SUB-LINE"

                            || "AIG-INTERNAL-COVERAGE"

                            || "AIG-LOCATION"

                            || "AIG-POLICY-LIMIT"

                            || "AIG-ISO-CLASS-CODE"

                            || "AIG-LOSS-CODE"

                            || "AIG-NEW-CLAIM-IND"

                            || "AIG-LOSS-TRANS-CODE"

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER4_1"

                            || nvl("AIG_ACCT_GT_10K", ' ')

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER4_2"

                            || "STATUTORY-CO-ORIG"

                            || "CONTRACT-ASMD"

                            || "STATUTORY-CO-ASMD"

                            || "BOOKED-DATE"

                            || "STATUS-CODE"

                            || "EXPOSURE-AMOUNT"

                            || "SURPLUS-LINES"

                            || "PROCESSING-DATE"

                            || "BUSINESS-TYPE"

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER5"

                            || "URS-TREATY-NUM"

                            || "URS-TREATY-COMPANY"

                            || "URS-CLAIM-NUM"

                            || "URS-RETRO-NUM"

                            || "FAC-CERTIFICATE"

                            || "RISK-STATE"

                            || "FAC-BROKER-NUM"

                            || "INSURED-NAME"

                            || "FISERVE-FILLER3"

                            || "FILE-SOURCE-INDICATOR"

                            || "AIG-BRANCH-CODE"

                            || "AIG-COUNTRY-CODE"

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER6_1"

                            || nvl("AIG-ACCOUNT#_B", "AIG-ACCOUNT#_A")

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER6_2"

                            || "WRITTEN_EXP_UNIT"     --Added new after new format file - BEGIN

                            || "UNEARNED_EXP_UNIT"

                            || "EARNED_EXP_UNIT"

                            || "FISERV-FILLER4"       --Added new after new format file - BEGIN

                            || "AIG-PREMIUM-TRANS-CD"

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER7"

                            || "FAC-RECORD-INDICATOR"

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER8"

                            || "ACCOUNT-DATE"

                            || "REINSURANCE-TYPE"

                            || "CONTRACT-PLACEMENT-PERCENT"

                            || "CONTRACT-EXPERIENCE-DATE"

                            || "UPR-FORMULA-CODE"

                            || "INSTALLMENT-TREATY-IND"

                            || "PREM-PORT-TRANS-IND"

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER9"

                            || "DIRECT-COMMISSION-PCT"

                            || "INITIAL-BALANCE-IND"

                            || "FISERV-FILLER5"

                            || "COMMISSION"

                            || "BROKERAGE"

                            || "OVERRIDE"

                            || "WRITTEN-PREM"

                            || "INFORCE-PREM"

                            || "EARNED-PREM"

                            || "CURRENT-UNEARNED-PREM"

                            || "PREVIOUS-UNEARNED-PREM"

                            || "FAC-WRITTEN-PREM"

                            || "FAC-COMMISSION"

                            || "COLLECTED-PREM"

                            || "DIRECT-COMMISSION"

                            || "COLLECTED-PREM-COMMISSION"

                            || "COLLECTED-PREM-OVERRIDE" AS "FISERV PREMIUM RECORD",

                            in_ym,

                            systimestamp

                        FROM

                            main_qry a

                            LEFT OUTER JOIN acc_prm  b ON rtrim("POLICY-NUMBER") = rtrim("POLICY-NUMBER_B")

                                                         AND rtrim("POLICY-EFFECTIVE") = rtrim("POLICY-EFFECTIVE_B")

                                                         AND rtrim("AIG-ACCOUNT#_B") = rtrim("ACCOUNT_NO")

                    );

 

            v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

            COMMIT;

            pk_error_log.pr_log_end_event(v_error_log_sk, v_rows_processed);

            INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

                v_module_name

                || ' - '

                || v_ym

                || ' - '

                || v_month_sk

                || ' - '

                || v_fulldate

                || ' - '

                || v_prev_month_sk,

                0,

                sysdate,

                '01- End P1'

            );

 

            COMMIT;

        END LOOP;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_cip_premium_feed_load;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_cip_premium_control_load (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.CIP_PRM_CONTROL';

        v_rows_processed := 0;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- Begin P1'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_prm_control_details

        WHERE

            param_num = in_ym;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_prm_control_details (

            fiserv_premium_record,

            param_num,

            load_timestamp

        )

            SELECT

                prod_cd

                || lpad(no_of_lines, 8, 0)

                || lpad(prm_am, 13, 0) AS "FISERV PREMIUM RECORD",

                in_ym,

                systimestamp

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT

                        prod_cd,

                        no_of_lines,

                        to_char(trunc(prm_am))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(prm_am) - TO_NUMBER(prm_am)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN prm_am > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN prm_am < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(prm_am) - TO_NUMBER(prm_am)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) prm_am

                    FROM

                        (

                            SELECT

                                TRIM(substr(b.fiserv_premium_record, 262, 3)) prod_cd,

                                COUNT(*)                                      no_of_lines,

                                nvl(SUM(TRIM(substr(b.fiserv_premium_record, 847, 17))),

                                    0)                                        prm_am

                            FROM

                                STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_premium_feed_details b

                            WHERE

                                param_num = in_ym   --8.Added NVL to avoild the failure if no transactions present as part of US536949

                            GROUP BY

                                TRIM(substr(b.fiserv_premium_record, 262, 3))

                        )

                );

 

        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_prm_control_details (

            fiserv_premium_record,

            param_num,

            load_timestamp

        )

            SELECT

                prod_cd,

                in_ym,

                systimestamp

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT

                        'CPA00000000000000000000{' prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'CPE00000000000000000000{' prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'CPI00000000000000000000{' prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'CHO00000000000000000000{' prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PAP00000000000000000000{' prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'HOP00000000000000000000{' prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PIM00000000000000000000{' prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PEL00000000000000000000{' prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PEQ00000000000000000000{' prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'FLD00000000000000000000{' prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                )

            WHERE

                substr(prod_cd, 1, 3) NOT IN (

                    SELECT

                        substr(fiserv_premium_record, 1, 3) prod_cd

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_prm_control_details

                    WHERE

                        param_num = in_ym

                );

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_prm_control_details (

            fiserv_premium_record,

            param_num,

            load_timestamp

        )

            SELECT

                prod_cd

                || lpad(no_of_lines, 8, 0)

                || lpad(prm_am, 13, 0) AS "FISERV PREMIUM RECORD",

                in_ym,

                systimestamp

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT

                        prod_cd,

                        no_of_lines,

                        to_char(trunc(prm_am))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(prm_am) - TO_NUMBER(prm_am)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN prm_am > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN prm_am < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(prm_am) - TO_NUMBER(prm_am)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) prm_am

                    FROM

                        (

                            SELECT

                                'ALL'    prod_cd,

                                COUNT(*) no_of_lines,

                                nvl(SUM(TRIM(substr(b.fiserv_premium_record, 847, 17))),

                                    0)   prm_am

                            FROM

                                STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_premium_feed_details b

                            WHERE

                                param_num = in_ym --8.Added NVL to avoild the failure if no transactions present as part of US536949

                        )

                );

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym

            || ' - '

            || v_month_sk

            || ' - '

            || v_fulldate

            || ' - '

            || v_prev_month_sk,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- End P1'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_cip_premium_control_load;

    PROCEDURE prc_cip_claims_feed_load (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

 

        v_prev_month_st_dt    tdate.actual_dt%TYPE;

        v_prev_month_st_dt_sk tdate.date_sk%TYPE;

        v_begin_dt            DATE;

        v_end_dt              DATE;

        v_begin_dt_sk         NUMBER;

        v_end_dt_sk           NUMBER;

        CURSOR c1 IS

        SELECT

            MIN(date_sk)   begin_dtsk,

            MIN(actual_dt) begin_dt,

            MAX(date_sk)   end_dtsk,

            MAX(actual_dt) end_dt

        FROM

            tdate d

        WHERE

            pcs_month_acctng_ct = in_ym

        GROUP BY

            pcs_month_acctng_ct

        ORDER BY

            3;

 

    BEGIN

        FOR c1_rec IN c1 LOOP

            v_begin_dt := c1_rec.begin_dt;

            v_end_dt := c1_rec.end_dt;

            v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.CIP_CLAIMS';

            v_rows_processed := 0;

            v_log_params := '(in_YM==>'

                            || in_ym

                            || ');';

            pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

            INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

                v_module_name

                || ' - '

                || in_ym

                || ' - '

                || v_begin_dt

                || ' - '

                || v_end_dt,

                0,

                sysdate,

                '01- Begin P1'

            );

 

            COMMIT;

            DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_loss_feed_details

            WHERE

                param_num = in_ym;

 

            COMMIT;

            INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_loss_feed_details (

                fiserv_loss_record,

                param_num,

                load_timestamp

            )

                SELECT

                    *

                FROM

                    (

                        WITH main_qry AS (

                            SELECT

                                rpad(' ', 15, ' ')                    AS "Primary-Package-ID",

                                rpad(' ', 15, ' ')                    AS "Secondary-Package-ID",

                                rpad(a.policy_no, 15, ' ')            AS "POLICY-NUMBER",

                                rpad(decode(b.cip_uw_cd,

                                            NULL,

                                            ' ',

                                            substr(b.cip_uw_cd, 3, 2)),

                                     2,

                                     ' ')                             AS "COMPANY-NUM",

                                rpad(' ', 2, ' ')                     AS "MODULE-NUM",

                                rpad(nvl(tc.account_no, ' '),

                                     10,

                                     ' ')                             AS "ACCOUNT_NO",

                                rpad(' ', 3, ' ')                     AS "UNIT-NUM",

                                rpad(to_char(a.inception_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                     10,

                                     ' ')                             AS "COVERAGE-EFFECTIVE",

                                rpad(to_char(a.inception_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                     10,

                                     ' ')                             AS "POLICY-EFFECTIVE",

                                rpad(' ', 1, ' ')                     AS "CLIENT-FILLER1",

                                decode(TRIM(b.wins_uw_cd),

                                       '0001',

                                       '1',

                                '+0000000000000.00'                   AS "ITD-PAID-LAE4",

                                '+0000000000000.00'                   AS "ITD-PAID-LAE5",

                                '+0000000000000.00'                   AS "ITD-PAID-LAE6",

                                '+0000000000000.00'                   AS "ITD-PAID-LAE7",

                                '+0000000000000.00'                   AS "ITD-PAID-LAE8",

                                '+0000000000000.00'                   AS "ITD-SALVAGE-LAE",

                                '+0000000000000.00'                   AS "ITD-SUBRO-LAE",

                                         (

                                        SELECT

                                            tclm_tran.claim_sk,

                                            tclm_tran.policy_sk,

                                            MAX(tclm_tran.transaction_dt_sk), --13.0 - Getting the MAX(tclm_tran.transaction_dt_sk) as required by US715762.

                                                CASE

                                                    WHEN td.pcs_month_acctng_ct = in_ym THEN

                                                    WHEN td.pcs_month_acctng_ct = in_ym THEN

                                                        0

                                                        tclm_tran.expense_paid_am

                                                    ELSE

                                                        0

                                                END

                                                CASE

                                                    WHEN td.pcs_month_acctng_ct = in_ym THEN

                                                        tclm_tran.loss_paid_am

                                                    ELSE

                                                        0

                                                END

                                            )                                 AS loss_paid_am,

                                            SUM(

                                                CASE

                                                    WHEN td.pcs_month_acctng_ct = in_ym THEN

                                                        tclm_tran.expense_paid_original_am

                                                    ELSE

                                                        0

                                                END

                                            )                                 AS expense_paid_original_am,

                                            SUM(

                                                CASE

                                                    WHEN td.pcs_month_acctng_ct = in_ym THEN

                                                        tclm_tran.loss_paid_original_am

                                                    ELSE

                                                        0

                                                END

                                            )                                 AS loss_paid_original_am,

                                            MAX(tclm_tran.claim_feature_sk)   AS claim_feature_sk,--13.0 - Getting the MAX(tclm_tran.claim_feature_sk) as required by US715762.

                                            SUM(tclm_tran.loss_reserve_am)    AS loss_reserve_am,

                                            SUM(tclm_tran.expense_reserve_am) AS expense_reserve_am

                                        FROM

                                            tclaim_transaction tclm_tran,

                                            tdate              td,

                                            tpolicy            tpol

                                        WHERE

                                                tclm_tran.transaction_dt_sk = td.date_sk

                                            AND tclm_tran.policy_sk = tpol.policy_sk

                                            AND td.pcs_month_acctng_ct <= in_ym

                                            AND tclm_tran.claim_sk IN (

                                                SELECT

                                                    a.claim_sk

                                                FROM

                                                    tclaim_transaction a, tdate              b

                                                WHERE

                                                        a.transaction_dt_sk = b.date_sk

                                                    AND b.pcs_month_acctng_ct = in_ym

                                            )

                                            AND ( tpol.source_system_sk IN ( 16, 17 )

                                                  OR ( tpol.source_system_sk IN ( 18, 19, 20, 21 ) --12.0 Added Instanda changes in DC loss feed and MISC_COVERAGE filter condition in premium

                                        GROUP BY

                                            tclm_tran.claim_sk,

                                            tclm_tran.policy_sk,

                                            --tclm_tran.transaction_dt_sk,  --13.0 - Removing the tclm_tran.transaction_dt_sk from the Group by Clause as it has been aggregated,  as required by US715762.

                                            tclm_tran.tran_type_sk,

                                            tclm_tran.coverage_sk

                                            --,tclm_tran.claim_feature_sk  --13.0 - Removing the tclm_tran.claim_feature_sk from the Group by Clause as it has been aggregated,  as required by US715762.

                                    ) l

 

                              /*(

                                  SELECT

                                     DISTINCT

                                     TCLM_TRAN.CLAIM_SK,

                                     TCLM_TRAN.POLICY_SK,

                                     TCLM_TRAN.TRAN_TYPE_SK,

                                     TCLM_TRAN.COVERAGE_SK,

                    FROM
