                              )L*/

                                    JOIN tclaim                       d ON d.claim_sk = l.claim_sk

                                    JOIN tpolicy                      a ON a.policy_sk = d.policy_sk

                                    JOIN tcustomer                    tc ON tc.customer_id = a.customer_id

                                    LEFT JOIN tclaim_features              e ON l.claim_feature_sk = e.claim_feature_sk

                                    LEFT JOIN tcovrg_type_dmnsn            ctd ON ctd.coverage_type_sk = e.coverage_type_sk

                              --LEFT JOIN tprimary_coverage TPC ON E.PRMCOV_SK = TPC.PRMCOV_SK

                                    LEFT JOIN ttransaction_type            m ON l.tran_type_sk = m.tran_type_sk

                                    LEFT JOIN tuw_company                  b ON TRIM(a.uw_co_cd) = TRIM(b.uw_co_cd_1)

                                    LEFT JOIN tlosstype                    k ON d.loss_type_sk = k.loss_type_sk

                                    LEFT JOIN ttype_of_loss                tol ON ( e.type_of_loss_sk = tol.type_of_loss_sk

                                                                     AND e.source_system_sk = a.source_system_sk )

                                    LEFT JOIN tpolicy_type                 g ON TRIM(a.policy_type_cd) = TRIM(g.policy_type_cd)

                                    LEFT JOIN tcoverage                    i ON l.coverage_sk = i.coverage_sk

                                    LEFT JOIN tpim_coverage                h ON l.coverage_sk = h.pim_coverage_sk

                                    LEFT JOIN tpel_coverage                j ON l.coverage_sk = j.pel_coverage_sk

                                    LEFT JOIN trisk_state_country          n ON a.risk_state_country_sk = n.risk_state_country_sk

                                    LEFT JOIN tprocessing_office           po ON TRIM(a.uw_center_nm) = TRIM(po.processing_office_desc_tx

                                    )

                                    LEFT JOIN STAGE_MISREG.stage_mjc_coveragecode smcc   --Added for DC Policies

                                     ON ( smcc.coverage_cd = ctd.covrg_type_cd

                                                                                     AND smcc.risk_state_cd = a.risk_state_cd

                                                                                     AND smcc.product_cd = (

                                        CASE

                                            WHEN a.source_system_sk IN ( 16, 17 ) THEN

                                                g.policy_type_cip_cd

                                            WHEN a.source_system_sk IN ( 18, 19, 20, 21 ) THEN

                                                g.policy_type_dc_cd

                                        END

                                    )

                                                                                     AND smcc.source_system_nm = (

                                        CASE

                                            WHEN a.source_system_sk IN ( 17 ) THEN

                                                'CIP'

                                            ELSE

                                                a.source_system_nm

                                        END

                                    ) )   --Modified the Join condition when SS='CIP-CANADA' in that case SMCC table stores as 'CIP' only.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            --Harikrishna Modified to Include Instanda changes in the filter condition

                                )

                            WHERE

                                TRIM(a.policy_type_cd) IN ( 'EXFL', 'HO', 'AU', 'PE', 'PC',

                                                            'EQ', 'CHO', 'CAU', 'YHT' )  --Harikrishna Modified to Include Instanda changes in the filter condition

                                AND a.source_system_sk IN ( 16, 17, 18, 19, 20,

                                                            21 )  --Harikrishna Modified to Include Instanda changes in the filter condition

                        ), acc_prm AS (

                            SELECT DISTINCT --13.0 - Adding the distinct since different month-end dates were having the same PCS_MONTH_ACCTNG_CT in the TDATE table, which were spawning duplicates. Done as a part of  US715762.

                                lpad(nvl(c.account_no, ' '),

                                     10,

                                     ' ')                  "AIG-ACCOUNT#_B",

                                rpad(nvl(aig_acct_gt_10k, ' '),

                                     1,

                                     ' ')                  "AIG_ACCT_GT_10K",

                                rpad(c.policy_no, 15, ' ') AS "POLICY-NUMBER_B",

                                rpad(to_char(effective_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),

                                     10,

                                     ' ')                  AS "POLICY-EFFECTIVE_B"

                            FROM

                                STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_prm_hist_details a,

                                tpolicy                              b,

                                STAGE_MISREG.stage_account_premium_details  c,

                                tdate                                d

                            WHERE

                                    a.policy_sk = b.policy_sk

                                AND a.account_no = c.account_no

                                AND a.policy_no = c.policy_no

                                AND a.inception_dt = c.effective_dt

                                AND a.month_sk = d.date_sk

                                AND d.pcs_month_acctng_ct = in_ym

                        )

                        SELECT

                            "Primary-Package-ID"

                            || "Secondary-Package-ID"

                            || "POLICY-NUMBER"

                            || "COMPANY-NUM"

                            || "MODULE-NUM"

                            || "UNIT-NUM"

                            || "COVERAGE-EFFECTIVE"

                            || "POLICY-EFFECTIVE"

                            || "CLIENT-FILLER1"

                            || "GR-BUSINESS-TYPE"

                            || "RECORD-TYPE"

                            || "LOSS-DATE"

                            || "CLAIM-OFFICE"

                            || "CLAIM-NUM"

                            || "FISERV-FILLER1"

                || v_fulldate

                || v_prev_month_sk,

                0,

                sysdate,

                '01- End P1'

            );

 

            COMMIT;

        END LOOP;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_cip_claims_feed_load;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_cip_claims_control_load (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

        v_begin_dt    DATE;

        v_end_dt      DATE;

        v_begin_dt_sk NUMBER;

        v_end_dt_sk   NUMBER;

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.CIP_CLAIMS_CONTROL';

        v_ym := in_ym;

        v_date := sysdate;

        v_rows_processed := 0;

        v_log_params := '(in_YM==>'

                        || v_ym

                        || ');';

        pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- Begin P1'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_loss_control_details

        WHERE

            param_num = in_ym;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_loss_control_details (

            fiserv_loss_record,

            param_num,

            load_timestamp

        )

            SELECT

                prod_cd

                || lpad(tot_lines, 8, '0')

                || lpad(os_loss_cnt, 8, '0')

                || lpad(os_loss, 14, '0')

                || lpad(os_lae_1, 14, '0')

                || '0000000000000{'

                || lpad(cc_paid_loss_cnt, 8, '0')

                || lpad(current_cycle_paid_loss, 14, '0')

                || lpad(cc_paid_lae_cnt, 8, '0')

                || lpad(current_cycle_paid_lae_1, 14, '0')

                || '00000000'

                || '0000000000000{'

                || lpad(cc_salvage_loss_cnt, 8, '0')

                || lpad(current_cycle_salvage_loss, 14, '0')

                || lpad(cc_subro_loss_cnt, 8, '0')

                || lpad(current_cycle_subro_loss, 14, '0') AS "FISERV LOSS RECORD",

                in_ym,

                systimestamp

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT

                        prod_cd,

                        tot_lines,

                        os_loss_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(os_loss))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_loss) - TO_NUMBER(os_loss)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN os_loss > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN os_loss < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_loss) - TO_NUMBER(os_loss)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) os_loss,

                        to_char(trunc(os_lae_cnt))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_lae_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(os_lae_cnt)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN os_lae_cnt > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN os_lae_cnt < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_lae_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(os_lae_cnt)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) os_lae_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(os_lae_1))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_lae_1) - TO_NUMBER(os_lae_1)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN os_lae_1 > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN os_lae_1 < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_lae_1) - TO_NUMBER(os_lae_1)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) os_lae_1,

                        to_char(trunc(cc_paid_loss_cnt))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_paid_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_paid_loss_cnt)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN cc_paid_loss_cnt > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN cc_paid_loss_cnt < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_paid_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_paid_loss_cnt)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) cc_paid_loss_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(current_cycle_paid_loss))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_paid_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_paid_loss)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN current_cycle_paid_loss > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN current_cycle_paid_loss < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_paid_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_paid_loss

                                               )),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) current_cycle_paid_loss,

                        to_char(trunc(cc_paid_lae_cnt))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_paid_lae_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_paid_lae_cnt)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN cc_paid_lae_cnt > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN cc_paid_lae_cnt < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_paid_lae_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_paid_lae_cnt)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) cc_paid_lae_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(current_cycle_paid_lae_1))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_paid_lae_1) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_paid_lae_1)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN current_cycle_paid_lae_1 > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN current_cycle_paid_lae_1 < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_paid_lae_1) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_paid_lae_1

                                               )),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) current_cycle_paid_lae_1,

                        to_char(trunc(cc_salvage_loss_cnt))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_salvage_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_salvage_loss_cnt)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN cc_salvage_loss_cnt > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN cc_salvage_loss_cnt < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_salvage_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_salvage_loss_cnt

                                               )),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) cc_salvage_loss_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(current_cycle_salvage_loss))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_salvage_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_salvage_loss)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN current_cycle_salvage_loss > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN current_cycle_salvage_loss < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_salvage_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_salvage_loss

                                               )),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) current_cycle_salvage_loss,

                        to_char(trunc(cc_subro_loss_cnt))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_subro_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_subro_loss_cnt)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN cc_subro_loss_cnt > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN cc_subro_loss_cnt < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_subro_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_subro_loss_cnt)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) cc_subro_loss_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(current_cycle_subro_loss))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_subro_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_subro_loss)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN current_cycle_subro_loss > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN current_cycle_subro_loss < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_subro_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_subro_loss

                                               )),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) current_cycle_subro_loss

                    FROM

                        (

                            SELECT

                                prod_cd,

                                COUNT(*)                        tot_lines,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN os_loss <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               os_loss_cnt,

                                SUM(os_loss)                    os_loss,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN os_lae_1 <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               os_lae_cnt,

                                SUM(os_lae_1)                   os_lae_1,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN current_cycle_paid_loss <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               cc_paid_loss_cnt,

                                SUM(current_cycle_paid_loss)    current_cycle_paid_loss,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN current_cycle_paid_lae_1 <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               cc_paid_lae_cnt,

                                SUM(current_cycle_paid_lae_1)   current_cycle_paid_lae_1,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN current_cycle_salvage_loss <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               cc_salvage_loss_cnt,

                                SUM(current_cycle_salvage_loss) current_cycle_salvage_loss,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN current_cycle_subro_loss <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               cc_subro_loss_cnt,

                                SUM(current_cycle_subro_loss)   current_cycle_subro_loss

                            FROM

                                (

                                    SELECT

                                        TRIM(substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 262, 3)) prod_cd,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 1227, 17) ) os_loss,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 1244, 17) ) os_lae_1,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 819, 17) )  current_cycle_paid_loss,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 836, 17) )  current_cycle_paid_lae_1,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 972, 17) )  current_cycle_salvage_loss,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 1006, 17) ) current_cycle_subro_loss,

                                        TRIM(substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 31, 15)) pol_no

                                    FROM

                                        STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_loss_feed_details b

                                    WHERE

                                            param_num = in_ym

                                        AND TRIM(substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 31, 15)) IN (

                                            SELECT

                                                policy_no

                                            FROM

                                                tpolicy

                                            WHERE

                                                source_system_sk IN ( 16, 17 ) -- 10. Added policy filter condition

                                        )

                                )

                            GROUP BY

                                prod_cd

                        )

                );

 

        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_loss_control_details (

            fiserv_loss_record,

            param_num,

            load_timestamp

        )

            SELECT

                prod_cd,

                in_ym,

                (

                    SELECT

                        'CPA00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'CPE00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'CPI00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'CHO00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PAP00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'HOP00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PIM00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PEL00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                    SELECT

            WHERE

                substr(prod_cd, 1, 3) NOT IN (

                    WHERE

        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        pk_error_log.pr_log_end_event(v_error_log_sk, v_rows_processed);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            || v_ym,

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            pk_error_log.pr_log_err_event(v_error_log_sk, dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace, sqlerrm);

            RAISE;

    END prc_cip_claims_control_load;

 

    PROCEDURE prc_dc_claims_control_load (

        in_ym NUMBER := TO_NUMBER ( to_char(add_months(sysdate, - 1),

                                            'YYYYMM') )

    ) IS

        v_begin_dt    DATE;

        v_end_dt      DATE;

        v_begin_dt_sk NUMBER;

        v_end_dt_sk   NUMBER;

    BEGIN

        v_module_name := $$plsql_unit || '.DC_CLAIMS_CONTROL';

        v_ym := in_ym;

        v_date := sysdate;

        v_rows_processed := 0;

        v_log_params := '(in_YM==>'

                        || v_ym

                        || ');';

        pk_error_log.pr_log_strt_event(v_module_name, v_log_params, v_error_log_sk);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym,

            0,

            sysdate,

            '01- Begin P1'

        );

 

        COMMIT;

        DELETE FROM STAGE_MISREG.stage_dc_loss_control_details

        WHERE

            param_num = in_ym;

 

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_dc_loss_control_details (

            fiserv_loss_record,

            param_num,

            load_timestamp

        )

            SELECT

                prod_cd

                || lpad(tot_lines, 8, '0')

                || lpad(os_loss_cnt, 8, '0')

                || lpad(os_loss, 14, '0')

                || lpad(os_lae_1, 14, '0')

                || '0000000000000{'

                || lpad(cc_paid_loss_cnt, 8, '0')

                || lpad(current_cycle_paid_loss, 14, '0')

                || lpad(cc_paid_lae_cnt, 8, '0')

                || lpad(current_cycle_paid_lae_1, 14, '0')

                || '00000000'

                || '0000000000000{'

                || lpad(cc_salvage_loss_cnt, 8, '0')

                || lpad(current_cycle_salvage_loss, 14, '0')

                || lpad(cc_subro_loss_cnt, 8, '0')

                || lpad(current_cycle_subro_loss, 14, '0') AS "FISERV LOSS RECORD",

                in_ym,

                systimestamp

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT

                        prod_cd,

                        tot_lines,

                        os_loss_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(os_loss))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_loss) - TO_NUMBER(os_loss)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN os_loss > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN os_loss < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_loss) - TO_NUMBER(os_loss)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) os_loss,

                        to_char(trunc(os_lae_cnt))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_lae_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(os_lae_cnt)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN os_lae_cnt > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN os_lae_cnt < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_lae_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(os_lae_cnt)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) os_lae_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(os_lae_1))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_lae_1) - TO_NUMBER(os_lae_1)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN os_lae_1 > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN os_lae_1 < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(os_lae_1) - TO_NUMBER(os_lae_1)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) os_lae_1,

                        to_char(trunc(cc_paid_loss_cnt))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_paid_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_paid_loss_cnt)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN cc_paid_loss_cnt > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN cc_paid_loss_cnt < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_paid_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_paid_loss_cnt)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) cc_paid_loss_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(current_cycle_paid_loss))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_paid_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_paid_loss)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN current_cycle_paid_loss > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN current_cycle_paid_loss < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_paid_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_paid_loss

                                               )),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) current_cycle_paid_loss,

                        to_char(trunc(cc_paid_lae_cnt))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_paid_lae_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_paid_lae_cnt)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN cc_paid_lae_cnt > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN cc_paid_lae_cnt < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_paid_lae_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_paid_lae_cnt)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) cc_paid_lae_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(current_cycle_paid_lae_1))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_paid_lae_1) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_paid_lae_1)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN current_cycle_paid_lae_1 > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN current_cycle_paid_lae_1 < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_paid_lae_1) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_paid_lae_1

                                               )),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) current_cycle_paid_lae_1,

                        to_char(trunc(cc_salvage_loss_cnt))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_salvage_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_salvage_loss_cnt)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN cc_salvage_loss_cnt > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN cc_salvage_loss_cnt < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_salvage_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_salvage_loss_cnt

                                               )),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) cc_salvage_loss_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(current_cycle_salvage_loss))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_salvage_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_salvage_loss)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN current_cycle_salvage_loss > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN current_cycle_salvage_loss < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_salvage_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_salvage_loss

                                               )),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) current_cycle_salvage_loss,

                        to_char(trunc(cc_subro_loss_cnt))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_subro_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_subro_loss_cnt)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN cc_subro_loss_cnt > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN cc_subro_loss_cnt < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(cc_subro_loss_cnt) - TO_NUMBER(cc_subro_loss_cnt)),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) cc_subro_loss_cnt,

                        to_char(trunc(current_cycle_subro_loss))

                        || TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_subro_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_subro_loss)),

                                                    '09.99'),

                                            - 2,

                                            1))

                        || f_zone_decimal_conv(to_char((

                            CASE

                                WHEN current_cycle_subro_loss > 0 THEN

                                    '+'

                                WHEN current_cycle_subro_loss < 0 THEN

                                    '-'

                                ELSE

                                    '+'

                            END

                        )),

                                               TO_NUMBER(substr(to_char(abs(trunc(current_cycle_subro_loss) - TO_NUMBER(current_cycle_subro_loss

                                               )),

                                                                        '09.99'),

                                                                - 1,

                                                                1))) current_cycle_subro_loss

                    FROM

                        (

                            SELECT

                                prod_cd,

                                COUNT(*)                        tot_lines,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN os_loss <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               os_loss_cnt,

                                SUM(os_loss)                    os_loss,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN os_lae_1 <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               os_lae_cnt,

                                SUM(os_lae_1)                   os_lae_1,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN current_cycle_paid_loss <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               cc_paid_loss_cnt,

                                SUM(current_cycle_paid_loss)    current_cycle_paid_loss,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN current_cycle_paid_lae_1 <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               cc_paid_lae_cnt,

                                SUM(current_cycle_paid_lae_1)   current_cycle_paid_lae_1,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN current_cycle_salvage_loss <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               cc_salvage_loss_cnt,

                                SUM(current_cycle_salvage_loss) current_cycle_salvage_loss,

                                SUM(

                                    CASE

                                        WHEN current_cycle_subro_loss <> 0 THEN

                                            1

                                        ELSE

                                            0

                                    END

                                )                               cc_subro_loss_cnt,

                                SUM(current_cycle_subro_loss)   current_cycle_subro_loss

                            FROM

                                (

                                    SELECT

                                        TRIM(substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 262, 3)) prod_cd,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 1227, 17) ) os_loss,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 1244, 17) ) os_lae_1,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 819, 17) )  current_cycle_paid_loss,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 836, 17) )  current_cycle_paid_lae_1,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 972, 17) )  current_cycle_salvage_loss,

                                        ( substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 1006, 17) ) current_cycle_subro_loss,

                                        TRIM(substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 31, 15)) pol_no

                                    FROM

                                        STAGE_MISREG.stage_cip_loss_feed_details b

                                    WHERE

                                            param_num = in_ym

                                                            --AND (SUBSTR(FISERV_LOSS_RECORD, 31, 10),to_date(SUBSTR(FISERV_LOSS_RECORD, 63, 10),'yyyy-mm-dd'))

                                        AND ( TRIM(substr(b.fiserv_loss_record, 31, 10)), TO_DATE(substr(fiserv_loss_record, 63, 10),

        'yyyy-mm-dd') ) IN (

                                            SELECT

                                                policy_no, inception_dt

                                            FROM

                                                tpolicy

                                            WHERE

                                                source_system_sk IN ( 18, 19, 20, 21 )  --Harikrishna Modified to Include Instanda changes in the filter condition

                                                AND ( inception_dt >= '01-JAN-2025' ) -- 10. Added policy filter condition

                                        )

                                )

                            GROUP BY

                                prod_cd

                        )

                );

 

        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.stage_dc_loss_control_details (

            fiserv_loss_record,

            param_num,

            load_timestamp

        )

            SELECT

                prod_cd,

                in_ym,

                systimestamp

            FROM

                (

                    SELECT

                        'CPA00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'CPE00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'CPI00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'CHO00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PAP00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'HOP00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PIM00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PEL00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'PEQ00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                    UNION

                    SELECT

                        'FLD00000000000000000000000000000{0000000000000{0000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{000000000000000000000{'

                        prod_cd

                    FROM

                        dual

                )

            WHERE

                substr(prod_cd, 1, 3) NOT IN (

                    SELECT

                        substr(fiserv_loss_record, 1, 3) prod_cd

                    FROM

                        STAGE_MISREG.stage_dc_loss_control_details

                    WHERE

                        param_num = in_ym

                );

 

        v_rows_processed := v_rows_processed + SQL%rowcount;

        COMMIT;

        pk_error_log.pr_log_end_event(v_error_log_sk, v_rows_processed);

        INSERT INTO STAGE_MISREG.t_error_log_status VALUES (

            v_module_name

            || ' - '

            || v_ym,

            0,

            '01- End P1'

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION

        WHEN OTHERS THEN
